components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: A modal dialog that asks the user to confirm a destructive action.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Visibility change callback.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title. Linked via aria-labelledby.

props.name: description
props.description: Consequence description. Linked via aria-describedby.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Action button label.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when action button is clicked. Does NOT auto-close.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Cancel button label.

props.name: actionVariant
props.description: Action button variant.

props.name: isActionLoading
props.description: Shows loading spinner on the action button.

props.name: width
props.description: Requested dialog width. Dialog preserves this preferred width and clamps it to the container and dynamic viewport with token gutters.

props.name: isInline
props.description: Renders alert dialog content inline without modal behavior. For documentation previews and showcases only. Not being a modal, the inline path renders role="group" instead of role="alertdialog".

components.name: AppShell
components.description: AppShell is the page shell for an application. It provides slots for top navigation, side navigation, banners, and main content. Use it as the root wrapper for every page. It handles responsive mobile navigation and skip-to-content automatically. Configure side nav collapse on SideNav with its collapsible prop.

props.name: children
props.description: Main content area, rendered inside a <main> element.

props.name: contentPadding
props.description: Padding for the main content area. Set based on the dominant content pattern: 4 (16px) for forms/settings/text, 0 for dashboards/maps/tables. Override individual sections with Section.

props.name: topNav
props.description: Top navigation slot, typically TopNav.

props.name: sideNav
props.description: Side navigation slot, typically SideNav.

props.name: mobileNav
props.description: Mobile navigation configuration. Accepts false (disable), a config object (tune auto behavior), or ReactNode (full custom drawer). The config object is {hasToggle?: boolean, isOpen?: boolean, onOpenChange?: (isOpen: boolean) => void, content?: ReactNode, breakpoint?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | 'none', defaultIsMobile?: boolean}; breakpoint defaults to 'md', resolves through the nearest Theme's widthBreakpoints, and switches to the wider layout at equality. 'none' is always non-mobile and ignores defaultIsMobile.

props.name: banner
props.description: Banner slot for system-wide announcements, placed above the topNav.

props.name: height
props.description: Height behavior: 'fill' makes the shell fill the viewport (100dvh) with independent scroll containers; 'auto' lets the shell grow with content and uses sticky positioning for nav.

props.name: variant
props.description: Navigation background style controlling how nav areas contrast with content. 'wash' uses wash background, 'surface' uses surface background, 'section' adds dividers between nav and content, 'elevated' uses wash nav with elevated surface content and border radius.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes. Use it for media containers like videos, images, thumbnails, or any content that needs consistent proportions. It takes its width from the container and derives its height from the ratio, so it needs an ancestor with a definite width.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Aspect ratio as width/height (e.g. 16/9, 1). Emitted as a class-level declaration (never inline), so `xstyle` rules or unlayered consumer CSS can override it responsively.

props.name: shape
props.description: Container shape. Both respect the `ratio`. `ellipse` clips to an oval (a circle when `ratio={1}`).

props.name: fit
props.description: How the child is sized inside the ratio box. `cover` fills and crops media, `contain` fills and letterboxes, `center` keeps the natural size centered. When omitted, the child styles itself.

props.name: children
props.description: Content positioned absolutely to fill the container.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Displays a user avatar with image, initials fallback, and optional status indicator.

props.name: src
props.description: Primary image source URL.

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.description: Fallback image when primary fails.

props.name: name
props.description: User name for initials and alt text.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text (falls back to name).

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar size: named sizes are 'xsm' (20px), 'sm' (24px), 'md' (36px), 'lg' (48px), and 'xl' (128px); numeric sizes must be one of the pixel values listed in the type. Inside an AvatarGroup, the group's size always overrides this prop, including when the group uses its default size.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape variant of the avatar. 'circle' (default) stays fully round. 'rounded' uses the element radius token so it matches UI corner rounding and can be set globally via theme. 'square' has no radius. Status dot positioning adapts automatically: 4-o'clock on circle, bottom-right corner on rounded/square.

props.name: status
props.description: Corner content for status indicators. AvatarStatusDot reports its `label` to the avatar, which composes it into the accessible name (e.g. "Jane Doe, Online") so screen readers announce the status. Reporting goes through context, so it still works when the dot sits inside a wrapper component of your own.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip shown on hover and keyboard focus. Omitted or true shows the avatar's name; a string shows that text instead; false shows no tooltip. Not auto-disabled when wrapped in your own Tooltip/HoverCard. Set tooltip={false} if you supply your own overlay. No tooltip is shown when tooltip is true/omitted and there is no name.

props.name: href
props.description: When set, the avatar renders as an interactive link (`<a>` or a custom link component) pointing here. This follows the same element-swap rule as Button. Requires a meaningful accessible name via `alt` or `name`: an interactive avatar without one warns in development. Inside an AvatarGroup, interactive avatars share a single Tab stop and are reached with arrow keys.

props.name: as
props.description: Custom link component used when `href` is set (e.g. `next/link`). Overrides the provider-level LinkProvider default. Only applies with `href`.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target attribute. Only applies with `href`.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link rel attribute. Only applies with `href`.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. When set without `href`, the avatar renders as a focusable `<button type="button">`. Requires a meaningful accessible name via `alt` or `name`: an interactive avatar without one warns in development.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: Stacked avatar display with overlapping layout and optional overflow indicator. Children are Avatar elements.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar children, optionally followed by one AvatarGroupOverflow. Consumers handle slicing to the desired visible count.

props.name: size
props.description: Size applied to all avatars: named sizes are 'xsm' (20px), 'sm' (24px), 'md' (36px), 'lg' (48px), and 'xl' (128px); numeric sizes must be one of the pixel values listed in the type. The group's size always overrides each child Avatar's size, including when the group uses its default size.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape applied to all avatars via context, overriding each avatar's own shape prop. Also applied to AvatarGroupOverflow's "+N" indicator.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: AvatarGroupOverflow
components.description: Overflow indicator for AvatarGroup. Shows a compact count for hidden avatars and can render custom count text or act as a button.

props.name: count
props.description: The number of hidden avatars. Used for the default `+N` label and the accessible label.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional custom count text rendered inside the indicator. Omit to use the default `+N` label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback fired when the overflow indicator is clicked. When provided, the indicator renders as a focusable button.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the overflow indicator element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: stylex.create() value — not an inline style object.

components.name: AvatarStatusDot
components.description: Size-aware status indicator dot that reads avatar size from context and scales proportionally. Each variant pairs a colour with a distinct built-in shape (filled, ring, minus) so status is never conveyed by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic variant pairing colour with a distinct shape: success = filled green dot, neutral = grey ring, error = red dot with a minus bar.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label describing the status. Inside an Avatar it is composed into the avatar's accessible name (e.g. "Jane Doe, Online"); the Avatar root is role="img", which prunes child semantics, so the composed name is how the status reaches assistive tech. Standalone dots expose role="img" with this label directly.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon centered inside the dot (hidden at tiny sizes). A rendered icon replaces the built-in shape glyph, so use a different icon per status.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance. Use it sparingly: only when a value represents a distinct state (Active, Failed) or a grouping tag (Engineering, Design). Most metadata (dates, durations, counts, descriptions) should be plain description text, not badges.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant. Semantic variants (neutral, info, success, warning, error) use solid backgrounds. Non-semantic color variants use tinted backgrounds with colored text for categorization and tagging.

props.name: label
props.description: Badge text content. A badge is one line and at least as tall as that line of its label, so it grows with its text (a larger text size); a label wider than the space available is cut with an ellipsis rather than escaping its container; a string or number label is also set as the badge's title so the full text stays reachable on hover.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon.

components.name: Banner
components.description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section. Use it for form errors, system updates, maintenance notices, or success confirmations that the user needs to see until they act on it.

props.name: status
props.description: Status type controlling icon and color.

props.name: title
props.description: Title text or ReactNode displayed in the header.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text rendered below the title in the header.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default status icon.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Whether the banner can be dismissed by the user.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the dismiss button is clicked; banner hides itself regardless of whether this is provided.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name and visible tooltip for the dismiss button (pass it already translated). Defaults to "Dismiss <title>" for a string title, so stacked banners are distinguishable; set it when the title is a ReactNode.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Action content rendered in the header area, end-aligned. Wraps to its own row below the text when the header is too narrow to hold both.

props.name: container
props.description: Container type: card has border-radius; section is full-width with no border-radius for page-level use.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting shadow depth. Use for a floating banner that hovers above content; `none` is the default inline banner. A `card`-container banner rounds its shadow to match.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered in the card-background area below the colored header. Sits behind an expand/collapse toggle unless `collapsible={false}`.

props.name: collapsible
props.type: boolean | {defaultIsOpen?: boolean; isOpen?: boolean; onOpenChange?: (isOpen: boolean) => void}
props.description: Whether the content area (children) sits behind an expand/collapse toggle in the header. On by default, starting collapsed. `false` opts out: children are always visible with no toggle. `{defaultIsOpen: true}` starts open; `{isOpen, onOpenChange}` is controlled. Takes the same CollapsibleConfig as Collapsible.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: BaseTypeahead
components.description: Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown. It renders no input wrapper, border, or selected-value token. Typeahead and Tokenizer compose it for standard fields.

props.name: searchSource
props.description: Data source providing search and bootstrap methods. `search(query, context)` may call `context.update(items)` to show matches it already has before it returns; the value it returns is the final list, and every list after the first for a query keeps the shown rows first and adds new rows after them.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected item.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Custom render function for dropdown items.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Input placeholder text.

props.name: hasEntriesOnFocus
props.description: Show bootstrap results on focus before typing.

props.name: maxMenuItems
props.description: Maximum dropdown items to display.

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Requested dropdown width in pixels before viewport clamping.

props.name: minQueryLength
props.description: Minimum query length before the search source is queried. Below it no search runs and the menu stays closed.

props.name: emptySearchText
props.description: Content shown when the query matched nothing. Takes a ReactNode, so the dead end can carry a link or a create row. Announced in a polite live region as the text it renders, read from the DOM; aria-hidden parts stay out of both, and content that renders no text announces nothing. null counts as not given, like undefined, and falls through to the default; pass an empty string to render nothing.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: isFocusableDisabled
props.description: Keep a disabled input focusable with aria-disabled and readOnly so a caller-owned disabled reason remains discoverable. It blocks text entry, opening the results and picking a result, also from results that were open before it applied; Escape or Tab still closes them.

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: Auto-focus the input on mount.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Debounce delay in ms before triggering search. Set to 0 for synchronous sources, and for a source that shows local matches through `context.update` and delays its own server request.

props.name: size
props.description: Size used to scale dropdown option padding.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Ref to the anchor element for dropdown positioning. If not provided, the input itself is used.

props.name: inputXStyle
props.description: Additional StyleX styles for the input element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: Standard BaseProps StyleX styles applied to the input. Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object.

props.name: inputTabIndex
props.description: Legacy input-specific alias for native tabIndex. When provided, it takes precedence; otherwise native tabIndex is preserved.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Additional keydown handler called before internal keyboard navigation. Call e.preventDefault() to skip internal handling.

props.name: onChangeQuery
props.description: Callback fired when the search query text changes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the dropdown opens or closes.

props.name: inputId
props.description: Legacy input-specific alias for native id. When provided, it takes precedence; otherwise native id is preserved.

props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description: Legacy input-specific alias for native aria-describedby. When provided, it takes precedence; otherwise the native attribute is preserved.

props.name: ariaLabelledBy
props.description: Legacy input-specific alias for native aria-labelledby. When provided, it takes precedence; otherwise the native attribute is preserved.

components.name: Blockquote
components.description: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color. Use to highlight quoted content, testimonials, or excerpts. The rule and padding are logical, so they move to the right edge in right-to-left locales.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the blockquote.

props.name: cite
props.description: Optional attribution for the quote. Rendered in a <cite> element after the quoted content.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.description: A mobile touch sheet that rises from the bottom edge, with animated entrance and exit, a grab handle, optional drag-to-resize snap points, and purpose-controlled dismissal. Like Dialog, it is a padded container: content starts at the theme's bottom-sheet padding (--spacing-4 by default), and a lone Section child or bleed children such as Table and Divider align against it. A sheet always owns a native <dialog>; inside the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher the switcher presents and closes that dialog as the flow moves between steps. In both modes, ref and shared DOM props target the visual panel <div>. Sheets stack: a sheet opened while another is open sits on top of it, the covered sheet stays mounted and recedes, and one scrim covers the page. A sheet that closes as another opens in the same update is replaced by it, with the step-to-step handoff a multi-step flow needs.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether a standalone sheet is open. Fully controlled; pair with onOpenChange. Omitted only inside the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher, which drives its steps itself.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: For a standalone sheet, called when it requests an open-state change. Automatic calls follow purpose: info dismisses on Escape, scrim click, or swipe; form dismisses on Escape only; required never dismisses implicitly. Omitted only inside the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher, which drives its steps itself.

props.name: finalFocusRef
props.description: Optional explicit focus-return target for a standalone sheet. Use when the opener can remount or the active element is not a reliable trigger, such as an adaptive presentation switch. Always focused when the sheet closes on its own or last; when a modal sheet is still open beneath, focus returns into that sheet (to this element if it is inside it, else the revealed panel). Omitted only inside the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher, which drives its steps itself.

props.name: purpose
props.description: Controls implicit dismissal behavior, matching Dialog. info allows Escape, scrim click, and swipe-to-dismiss. form protects entered data by blocking scrim click and swipe while allowing Escape. required blocks every implicit dismissal path and uses role='alertdialog'. Explicit controls may still update the controlled state. Works for standalone and BottomSheetSwitcher-managed sheets.

props.name: sheetId
props.description: Deprecated with BottomSheetSwitcher: give each step its own standalone sheet with isOpen instead. Still works as released: the unique ID of this sheet inside a BottomSheetSwitcher, which opens it when activeSheet matches; omit isOpen and onOpenChange when sheetId is used.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the sheet. Required; the sheet has no built-in heading to derive a name from.

props.name: children
props.description: Sheet content in a scrollable area. The named body is keyboard reachable while overflowing. Forward Tab entry may move directly to the first native link or button; input controls, composite widgets, and nested scroll areas retain the body stop. Shift+Tab from a delegated first child skips the body. Fitting content adds no body stop. The internal observed content box preserves block flow and percentage heights. If it includes a text-entry control that can bring up the mobile keyboard, use height='tall' and keep the sheet fully expanded while editing.

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding of the sheet content using the spacing scale, matching Dialog. When omitted, uses the theme default for bottom sheets (--spacing-4 unless the theme sets padding on bottom-sheet). A lone Section child escapes the padding, and bleed children such as Table and Divider compensate against it. Use 0 for edge-to-edge content that supplies its own inset.

props.name: height
props.description: How tall the sheet is. Named budgets: 'hug' fits its content up to 92% of the viewport, 'capped' is a scrolling mid-height panel (~62%), and 'tall' is a pinned near-full panel (~92%) for content that streams in. Or pass a number (px) / CSS length for a custom budget. Give snapPoints to let the user drag between heights. On shorter viewports the sheet fills the available height. Only a fully expanded 'tall' sheet provides mobile-keyboard accommodation: it stays put and scrolls each focused control above the keyboard. Hug, Capped, numeric and CSS-length heights never do, and a Tall sheet stops doing it the moment the user drags it to a shorter detent, resuming when they drag it back. Outside that state the sheet neither moves nor adds keyboard scroll space, and the browser's own focus reveal is left in place; on iOS that reveal can shift the whole page. This accommodation applies where the visual viewport shrinks for the keyboard, as in Safari on iOS, Firefox for Android and Chrome on Android, where the sheet places the focused control just above the keyboard as it comes up, and the control rides the rest of Gboard’s slide up, and the slide down after it loses focus; a hide Chrome reports late, such as Back, rides down from Chrome’s report (`astryx docs browser-support`).

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Extra heights the sheet can rest at when dragged; its own height is always the tallest stop, and omitting this gives a sheet that only opens and closes. Each stop is the sheet's visible height: a number is a viewport fraction (0.5 is half the screen), '50%' the same in CSS, '320px' an absolute length. A stop of a quarter of the sheet or less is a peek: it slides away instead of reflowing, and thins the scrim.

props.name: hasScrim
props.description: For a standalone BottomSheet, whether to render a scrim, the semi-transparent overlay that covers and blocks the background. true (default) uses showModal(): top layer, native focus containment, ::backdrop scrim, body scroll lock, and tap-scrim-to-dismiss when purpose='info', with the background inert. A scrim sheet also takes part in stacking (see Stacking below). false presents the sheet in the top layer as a manual popover (below the Popover API support floor, show() in page stacking order as a reduced fallback) with no scrim, no focus trap and no scroll lock, leaving the page behind interactive and scrollable; a no-scrim sheet neither stacks nor is stacked on, but no-scrim steps replace each other with the same handoff. A no-scrim sheet shown while a modal (a scrim sheet or a Dialog) that does not contain it is open is inert under that modal and stays beneath it (show(), no page-level z-index) until that modal has gone, then enters the top layer; a modal mid-exit counts as gone, and rendered inside the modal the sheet enters the top layer at once. In a multi-step flow, set hasScrim the same on every step.

components.name: BottomSheetSwitcher

deprecated.description: Write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step; moving on from inside the open step replaces it in place (see BottomSheet, Replacing a sheet). BottomSheetSwitcher keeps working until a future minor release removes it.

components.description: Deprecated: write each step as its own BottomSheet with isOpen, controlled by one state value that names the open step. Closing the top sheet and opening the next in the same update, from a control inside the open step, runs the same replace handoff (see BottomSheet, Replacing a sheet), with no sheetId and no switcher; a step changed from a control outside the flow (a page control, or code after focus left the step) closes and opens with ordinary push and pop motion. BottomSheetSwitcher keeps working until a future minor release removes it: a flow used on its own behaves as released (with two fixes: a toast raised from a step renders above the flow and can be pressed, and under reduced motion its steps follow the reduced-motion rule), and a flow stacked with other sheets is one level of the stack (it recedes and is blocked when covered, shares the one scrim, and stands down from dismissal while covered). Modal and hasScrim={false} flows migrate the same way. Coordinates multiple BottomSheets as a mutually exclusive flow. One activeSheet ID selects the only interactive sheet; during a handoff, the new sheet enters above the inert previous sheet. If the new sheet is shorter, the previous sheet simultaneously moves down until their top edges align, then fades after both transforms complete. Each child sheet renders its own native <dialog>: a modal flow presents each sheet with showModal(), as a standalone modal sheet does, so the browser supplies modality (the page is inert and focus stays in the top-layer dialog, so both hold across a handoff) and the switcher holds the shared body scroll lock once for the whole modal flow. A no-scrim flow presents each sheet with show() inside the isolated flow wrapper of the switcher, which orders the step dialogs with local values; this differs from a standalone hasScrim={false} sheet, which is hosted in the top layer as a manual popover with no page-level z-index, and it is one reason to migrate. The switcher coordinates the rest: one scrim paints at a time, focus returns to the element that opened the flow, its ref, id, and data-testid resolve to the dialog hosting the active sheet, and its other dialog props and handlers apply to every sheet dialog.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref resolved to the native dialog hosting the flow: the active sheet's dialog, which changes to the next sheet's on a handoff; the exiting sheet's through its exit; and, while the flow is closed, the dialog that hosted it last (or the first mounted sheet's). It is never null while a sheet is mounted, from the first commit on. id and data-testid render on this dialog only: a flow that mounts open carries them on the active sheet's dialog in server markup too; a flow that mounts closed carries them from the first commit's synchronous re-render on, and its server markup carries them on no element. Other dialog props apply to every sheet dialog.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called before the switcher handles a native cancel request (Escape or the platform close). Attached to every sheet dialog; the browser raises cancel on the dialog it is presenting, the active sheet's. Calling preventDefault() keeps the controlled flow open.

props.name: activeSheet
props.description: ID of the interactive BottomSheet, or null when the flow should close. Match a nested BottomSheet's unique sheetId; the previous sheet may remain visually present and inert while the new sheet enters, simultaneously align downward behind a shorter step, then fade away.

props.name: onActiveSheetChange
props.description: Called with null when the active sheet dismisses according to its purpose. Child BottomSheets may use purpose='form' or purpose='required' to limit implicit dismissal while flow controls can still use the same state setter to switch sheets or close the flow.

props.name: hasScrim
props.description: Whether the sheet dialogs are modal. true presents each sheet with showModal() for a native ::backdrop, native focus containment, one body scroll lock held for the whole flow, and click-to-dismiss when the active BottomSheet has purpose='info'; only one backdrop paints at a time. false uses show() with no backdrop and leaves the page interactive; avoid transformed, contained, or clipping ancestors because a non-modal dialog remains in its containing context.

props.name: children
props.description: BottomSheets identified by unique sheetId values.

components.name: BreadcrumbItem
components.description: Individual breadcrumb item that renders as a link when href is provided, or as plain text for the current page.

props.name: children
props.description: Label content for the breadcrumb item.

props.name: href
props.description: URL the breadcrumb links to; omit for non-navigable items.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler for the breadcrumb item.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks this item as the current page, applying aria-current="page". When omitted, the last item is auto-detected if no item is explicitly current; pass false to opt out.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the item label.

props.name: menu
props.description: Menu opened when the item is activated, using the same item API as DropdownMenu/MoreMenu/ContextMenu (a DropdownMenuOption[] array or composed DropdownMenuItem children). Renders a link-styled menu trigger with a chevron and aria-haspopup="menu". Takes precedence over href/onClick.

props.name: menuSize
props.description: Size passed to the menu items. Defaults from the breadcrumb variant ('supporting' → 'sm', otherwise 'md').

props.name: as
props.description: Custom link component to render instead of <a>. Overrides the provider-level default from LinkProvider. Only applies to non-current items.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Navigation container that renders a <nav> with an ordered list of breadcrumb items.

props.name: children
props.description: BreadcrumbItem elements to render inside the breadcrumb trail.

props.name: separator
props.description: Separator rendered between breadcrumb items. The built-in slash mirrors automatically in RTL.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant: supporting is smaller with secondary text styling.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the nav landmark (aria-label).

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Button
components.description: Button triggers an action when clicked. Use it for form submissions, confirmations, navigation, or any interaction that needs a clear call to action.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Rendered as visible text by default; used as aria-label when isIconOnly is true.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting shadow depth for floating buttons (e.g. a FAB). `none` is the default flat button; `low`/`med`/`high` map to the shadow token scale. Ignored inside a ButtonGroup, where elevation is owned by the group.

props.name: type
props.description: HTML button type attribute.

props.name: name
props.description: HTML name attribute for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: HTML value attribute for form submission.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the button with a form element by ID.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner and blocks re-activation while staying focusable (aria-busy + aria-disabled, not native disabled, so keyboard focus is never dropped mid-action). Announces "Loading" via a live region.

props.name: isInterruptible
props.description: Keep the button clickable while a clickAction is pending: the spinner and aria-busy still show, but the button is not disabled and the action is not deduped, so a re-click lands and interrupts the in-flight action with a fresh one.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the button. When a tooltip is present, uses aria-disabled instead of native disabled so the button stays focusable.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element rendered before the label text. An Astryx Icon with no explicit size defaults to sm for sm/md buttons and md for lg buttons.

props.name: isIconOnly
props.description: When true, renders as a square icon-only button with label as aria-label. Requires icon. Tip: for a dedicated icon-only button component, use IconButton from '@astryxdesign/core/IconButton' instead.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the button. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is (e.g., '100%' for a full-width button). By default the button sizes to its content, never grows past its container, and truncates its label with an ellipsis when a row is too narrow; icon-only buttons stay square.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional override for visible text. When provided, displayed instead of label, but label is still required (it provides the accessible name). For most cases, just use label alone: <Button label="Save" />.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Trailing icon or badge rendered after the label. Ignored when isIconOnly is true. Color is inherited from the button variant.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text shown on hover.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Standard click handler (passed through from ButtonHTMLAttributes).

props.name: clickAction
props.description: Async click handler. Shows loading state while the returned promise is pending.

props.name: href
props.description: When provided, renders the button as a link element (<a> or custom link component). The destination follows the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop.

props.name: as
props.description: Custom link component to use when href is provided (e.g. Next.js Link).

props.name: target
props.description: HTML target attribute when rendered as a link (e.g. "_blank").

props.name: rel
props.description: HTML rel attribute when rendered as a link (e.g. "noopener noreferrer").

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: ButtonGroup joins related actions into a single connected control. Use it when multiple buttons represent related choices or operations that belong together visually, like copy/cut/paste, or undo/redo.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use it in booking flows, scheduling UIs, date filters, or anywhere the user needs to see surrounding dates for context.

props.name: mode
props.description: Selection mode.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected value. Use null for no selection; omit value or pass undefined for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled default value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection callback.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Number of months to display.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum selectable date.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum selectable date.

props.name: dateConstraints
props.description: Custom constraint functions.

props.name: maxRangeSpan
props.description: Range mode: max days a range may span, both endpoints counted (7 = a 7-day window). Caps the window from the picked start; before a start is picked every day stays selectable.

props.name: minRangeSpan
props.description: Range mode: min days a range must span, both endpoints counted (2 forbids a single-day range). Clicking the start again commits a one-day range when allowed, or cancels the in-progress selection when the minimum is longer. Default 1.

props.name: focusDate
props.description: Controlled visible month. Unset, the calendar opens on the selected date, else on today clamped into the min/max window.

props.name: onFocusDateChange
props.description: Navigation callback.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Imperative handle for calendar navigation, including navigateTo().

props.name: hasOutsideDays
props.description: Show days from adjacent months.

props.name: hasWeekNumbers
props.description: Show ISO 8601 week numbers. They are ISO 8601 week numbers in every calendar system.

props.name: hasVariableRowCount
props.description: Give each month only the rows it needs. The default fixed 6-row grid keeps the same height from month to month; a variable row count trades that fixed height for a more compact grid.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of week. Accepts a number (0=Sunday) or a three-letter day name (e.g. "mon").

props.name: calendar
props.description: Calendar system the grid shows, such as 'persian', 'hebrew', or 'islamic-umalqura'. It sets the months, their names, and month and year navigation. value, min, max, focusDate, and every callback stay Gregorian ISO dates. Calendars other than gregory, iso8601, buddhist, roc, and japanese need Temporal; where the runtime lacks it, load a polyfill such as temporal-polyfill/full/global on the server and in the browser, or the grid shows Gregorian months. Month starts in the Chinese and Dangi calendars come from the runtime's Temporal, and some polyfills start a few months one day apart from native Temporal; when server and browser markup must match, use one implementation on both sides, such as installImplementation() from temporal-polyfill/full/shim, which replaces a native Temporal.

components.name: Card
components.description: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently. Cards are NOT the default layout tool. Most content groups don't need a container at all; spacing and alignment create visual grouping naturally. Only reach for a Card when items need clear interaction boundaries or visual comparison in a grid.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the card (number = pixels, string = used as-is). In a flex row or grid track this is the preferred width: the card shrinks below it when the row is narrower. To hold the width in a flex row, wrap the card in StackItem (static by default) and let the row wrap or scroll. In Grid, set a consumer minWidth on the Card and size the track accordingly.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the card (number = pixels, string = used as-is).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the card.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum height of the card.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the card.

props.name: padding
props.default: the theme's card padding (spacing step 4 with no theme)
props.description: Internal padding using the spacing scale. Omit it and the card takes the theme's card padding rather than a step, so passing a step is a decision to override the theme, not a way to restate the default.

props.name: variant
props.description: Background color variant. `default` uses the standard card background. `transparent` drops the background entirely. `muted` uses the muted background for de-emphasised cards. The non-semantic variants use the corresponding `--color-background-<name>` token.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting shadow depth. `none` is flat; `low`/`med`/`high` map to the shadow token scale. Raise a card only when it needs to float above surrounding content.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Carousel scrolls a row of items horizontally when they overflow the available width. Use it for card grids, image galleries, product lists, or any set of items that should be browsable without taking up the full page.

props.name: children
props.description: Carousel items rendered in a horizontal scroll container.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items using the spacing token scale.

props.name: hasButtons
props.description: Show prev/next navigation buttons when content is scrollable.

props.name: hasEdgeFade
props.description: Show a gradient edge-fade mask when content overflows, signalling that more items exist off-screen.

props.name: hasLoop
props.description: Wrap-around scrolling: next at the end scrolls to the start, prev at the start scrolls to the end. Buttons stay visible at both edges. Only engages when content overflows.

props.name: hasSnap
props.description: Enable scroll-snap so each child snaps to the start edge.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inline padding inside the scroll container, with matching scroll-padding so snap points align to the content edge.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the carousel region.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root element.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Imperative handle exposing scrollNext(), scrollPrev(), scrollTo(index), canScrollNext(), and canScrollPrev() for programmatic scroll control.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root element. Prefer xstyle.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: Center
components.description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container. Use it for empty states, loading screens, login forms, or any content that should sit in the center of the available space.

props.name: axis
props.description: Which Center mode to use. In horizontal writing, "horizontal" centers the flex main/inline axis and "vertical" centers the cross/block axis. In vertical writing, current single-axis behavior follows those logical flex axes rather than the physical names; "both" still centers both axes.

props.name: width
props.description: Container width (px or CSS value).

props.name: height
props.description: Container height (px or CSS value).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum container width (px or CSS value).

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum container height (px or CSS value).

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding on all sides, using the spacing scale (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10). Matches the padding prop on Stack, Card, LayoutContent, and LayoutPanel. Pass as a JSX number expression e.g. padding={3}.

props.name: paddingInline
props.description: Logical inline-axis padding, using the spacing scale. Overrides padding on the inline axis when both are set.

props.name: paddingInlineStart
props.description: Logical inline-start padding, using the spacing scale. Its resolved physical edge depends on writing mode and direction. Overrides paddingInline and padding on that edge only.

props.name: paddingInlineEnd
props.description: Logical inline-end padding, using the spacing scale. Its resolved physical edge depends on writing mode and direction. Overrides paddingInline and padding on that edge only.

props.name: paddingBlock
props.description: Logical block-axis padding, using the spacing scale. Overrides padding on the block axis when both are set.

props.name: paddingBlockStart
props.description: Logical block-start padding, using the spacing scale. Its resolved physical edge depends on writing mode. Overrides paddingBlock and padding on that edge only.

props.name: paddingBlockEnd
props.description: Logical block-end padding, using the spacing scale. Its resolved physical edge depends on writing mode. Overrides paddingBlock and padding on that edge only.

props.name: isInline
props.description: Use inline-flex (useful for text/icons).

props.name: children
props.description: Content to center.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Chat
components.description: Chat is a family of composable primitives for building AI and human chat experiences. Combine ChatLayout, ChatMessageList, ChatMessage, bubbles, system messages, tool calls, tokenized text, and ChatComposer to assemble complete conversations without reimplementing sender-aware layout, density, scrolling, or composer behavior.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.description: Layout shell for a chat composer. Arranges named slots (drawer, header, input, footer, send) with page-radius container, elevation, a keyboard-only editor focus ring, and concentric inner radius for child elements.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when the user submits a message.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user requests to stop generation.

props.name: isStopShown
props.description: Whether the stop button is shown instead of the send button.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Change handler for controlled mode.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the composer.

props.name: density
props.description: Visual density.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting elevation of the composer body. `low` (the default) keeps today's raised look: low at rest, bumping to med on hover / focus. `none` flattens it and draws a border. Keyboard focus in the editor adds the shared focus ring in either presentation; pointer focus does not add that ring.

props.name: drawer
props.description: Slot: collapsible drawer above the input: attachments, context chips, etc. Use ChatComposerDrawer.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Slot: left-aligned header actions (attach, mention buttons). Use icon-only size="sm" buttons.

props.name: headerContext
props.description: Slot: right-aligned contextual info in the header (context window usage, ProgressBar, supporting text).

props.name: input
props.description: Slot: custom input element. Replaces the default input. Use ChatComposerInput for trigger menus/tokens, or wire any input (plain textarea, rich editor) to the composition contract via useChatComposerContext(): read value/onChange/onSubmit/canSend and register a focus control on inputControlRef so body-click-to-focus works.

props.name: footerActions
props.description: Slot: left-aligned footer actions (model selector, etc).

props.name: sendActions
props.description: Slot: actions to the left of the send button.

props.name: sendButton
props.description: Slot: custom send button. Replaces the default send/stop button.

props.name: status
props.description: Status message rendered below (or above) the composer.

props.name: statusPosition
props.description: Where to render the status.

components.name: ChatComposerDrawer
components.description: Collapsible drawer panel that sits above the chat input inside ChatComposer. Pass it to the composer's `drawer` slot to show attachments, context chips, or any supplementary content. When `count` is provided the drawer gains a collapse toggle: collapsed state shows the default Badge and label or caller-provided `collapsedSummary`, while expanded state shows all children.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render inside the drawer: tokens, chips, previews, or any React elements.

props.name: count
props.description: Total item count shown in the collapsed badge. When provided, the drawer gains a collapse/expand toggle.

props.name: label
props.description: Label shown next to the count in the default collapsed summary and used to name the expand/collapse action.

props.name: collapsedSummary
props.description: Visual content for the complete Collapsed summary anatomy part. When count enables collapse, this replaces the default neutral Badge and label while the component retains disclosure behavior and accessible naming.

props.name: isCollapsed
props.description: Controlled collapsed state. Use with `onCollapsedChange` for external control.

props.name: defaultIsCollapsed
props.description: Initial collapsed state for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Callback fired when the user toggles the drawer.

components.name: ChatComposerInput
components.description: Rich text input for the chat composer. Supports trigger menus (type @ or / to open a typeahead), inline tokens rendered as badges, message history recall with ArrowUp/Down, paste/drop file handling, and a 16px iOS font-size floor to prevent input zoom. Pass it to ChatComposer's input slot when you need more than a plain textarea.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Imperative handle for programmatic control: insertToken, expandToken, insertText, focus, and getValue.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled input value. Pair with onChange for two-way binding.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the input value changes. The serialized string includes token placeholders.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Maximum visible rows before the input scrolls. Use a lower value in compact layouts.

props.name: triggers
props.description: Trigger definitions for typeahead menus. Each trigger specifies a character (@ or /), a search source, and an onSelect handler that returns the token to insert. Set hasMultiWordQuery: true when suggestions contain spaces (people, topics): the query then runs to a line break or about 64 characters instead of ending at the first space. Per-trigger emptySearchText (ReactNode) is the message when the query matched nothing.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Debounce delay for async search sources to avoid excessive network requests.

props.name: hasHistory
props.description: Enable ArrowUp/Down to recall previously submitted messages.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label announced by screen readers.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the input. Use during streaming or when a prerequisite is unmet.

props.name: onPaste
props.description: Called when plain text is pasted. Return true after handling the text yourself; otherwise ChatComposerInput inserts it or applies paste-as-token behavior.

props.name: pasteAsToken
props.description: Paste-as-token behavior. By default, plain-text pastes over 200 characters become expandable tokens. Pass false to keep every text paste inline, or provide useChatPasteAsToken() to customize the conversion.

props.name: onFiles
props.description: Called when files are pasted or dropped onto the input. Use to handle attachments.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when the user presses Enter without Shift. The serialized value includes token placeholders.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key-down handler invoked before the built-in Enter/history behavior (after any open trigger menu). The seam for platform-specific keys: call event.preventDefault() to suppress the default submit (e.g. newline on a touch keyboard), or act on the event yourself to add behavior (e.g. submit on Cmd/Ctrl+Enter). IME composition is always respected; Enter never submits mid-composition.

props.name: enterKeyHint
props.description: What the Return key of a touch keyboard says (the native enterkeyhint). Enter sends the message, so it defaults to send and iOS shows its Send key. When onKeyDown makes Enter insert a line break on touch keyboards, pass enter so the key shows Return again.

components.name: ChatComposerTokenElement
components.description: Renders a single token chip outside the contentEditable input. Wraps a badge config or custom render function in the correct data-astryx-token span so the token serializes properly and stays visually consistent with tokens inside the composer.

props.name: token
props.description: The token to render. Pass a badge config ({ value, label, variant?, icon? }) for the common case, or a custom render ({ value, render }) for full control.

components.name: ChatDictationButton
components.description: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer. It pairs with useChatDictation to show a microphone icon when idle and animated frequency bars when listening. Place it in the sendActions slot of ChatComposer.

props.name: dictation
props.description: The return value from useChatDictation or useSpeechRecognition. Controls all button state: listening, volume, bands, and toggle.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size. Matches ChatComposer density.

props.name: isHiddenWhenUnsupported
props.description: When true, renders nothing if the browser does not support SpeechRecognition. When false, keeps the button visible but disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label override. Defaults to "Start dictation" or "Stop dictation" based on state.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: ChatLayout
components.description: Layout shell for full chat interfaces. Messages flow in normal page flow, composer is fixed to the bottom with a frosted glass dock. Set density (compact/balanced/spacious) to control spacing, message max-width, and blur layer sizing. Includes built-in auto-scroll, a "New messages" scroll-to-bottom button, and a frosted glass blur layer behind the composer. By default the layout root is the scroll container; pass scrollRef to delegate scrolling to a parent element or the document body.

props.name: children
props.description: Message content: typically ChatMessageList. Flows naturally in the page and scrolls with the container.

props.name: composer
props.description: Composer element: typically ChatComposer. Fixed to the bottom with a frosted glass dock.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when children is empty. Centered vertically in the message area.

props.name: scrollButton
props.description: Scroll-to-bottom button rendered above the composer. Defaults to ChatLayoutScrollButton with auto-scroll integration. Pass null to hide.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: External scroll container ref. When provided, auto-scroll and scroll-to-bottom target this element instead of the layout root. Use when the chat is embedded in a page where a parent element or the document body scrolls.

props.name: density
props.description: Visual density: controls dock padding, message-area max-width and inline padding, and the height of the frosted glass blur layer.

components.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton
components.description: Floating scroll-to-bottom button that appears when the user scrolls away from the latest messages. It fades in as a compact icon button and expands to show a label when new messages arrive. ChatLayout renders this by default: pass a custom element to the scrollButton prop to override, or null to hide it entirely.

props.name: isVisible
props.description: Whether the button is visible. Bind to a scroll-position check so the button only appears when the user has scrolled up.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label that expands the button (e.g. "New messages"). Use to signal unread content below the fold.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler: typically scrolls to bottom and dismisses the new message indicator.

components.name: ChatMessage
components.description: Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.

props.name: sender
props.description: Who sent this message: controls alignment and layout.

props.name: children
props.description: Free-form content: bubbles, asset lists, tool calls, images. Custom (non-bubble) children render flush with the message edge; wrap them in a ghost ChatMessageBubble to align them with the bubble text column.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar element rendered beside the message. Typically Avatar. `null`, booleans, and empty strings create no slot; any other content that renders nothing collapses its slot.

props.name: name
props.description: Sender name rendered above the message body; it labels the message. `null`, booleans, and empty strings create no slot, and any other content that renders nothing collapses its slot; either way the message is labelled by the translated sender fallback. Use when the first child is raw content (not a bubble). If the first child is a bubble, put the name on the bubble's `name` prop instead.

props.name: metadata
props.description: Metadata rendered below the message body. `null`, booleans, and empty strings create no slot; any other content that renders nothing collapses its slot. Use when the last child is raw content (not a bubble). If the last child is a bubble, put metadata on the bubble's `metadata` prop instead.

props.name: density
props.description: Visual density. Inherited from list context if not set.

components.name: ChatMessageBubble
components.description: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary. Supports name/metadata slots aligned with bubble padding, and multi-bubble grouping via the group prop for consecutive messages from the same sender.

props.name: children
props.description: Bubble content: text, Markdown, or any ReactNode.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant. 'filled' renders sender-colored background (default). 'ghost' renders transparent background but keeps padding for alignment.

props.name: name
props.description: Sender name rendered above the bubble, aligned with bubble text padding. Use on the first bubble in a message. Non-rendering scalar values (null, undefined, booleans, and the empty string) omit the aligned wrapper; numeric 0 remains aligned. If the first content is raw (no bubble), use ChatMessage's `name` prop instead.

props.name: metadata
props.description: Metadata content rendered below the bubble, aligned with bubble text padding. Use on the last bubble in a message. Non-rendering scalar values (null, undefined, booleans, and the empty string) omit the aligned wrapper; numeric 0 remains aligned. If the last content is raw (no bubble), use ChatMessage's `metadata` prop instead.

props.name: group
props.description: Position within a multi-bubble group. Controls corner radius reduction on the sender side. Leave unset for standalone bubbles (full radius).

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the bubble (number = pixels, string = used as-is). When set, replaces the default max(80%, 280px) width cap. Combine with variant="ghost" to let custom content (an artifact card, attachments) span the full message column.

components.name: ChatMessageList
components.description: Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility. A flex spacer pushes messages to the bottom when the list isn't full; set align="top" to start messages at the top instead.

props.name: children
props.description: Message elements: typically ChatMessage or ChatSystemMessage.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Content shown when the list has no messages.

props.name: scrollToTopAction
props.description: Async action fired when user scrolls to top. Use for loading older messages. Wrapped in useTransition: shows a spinner at the top while pending.

props.name: density
props.description: Visual density: flows to child messages via context.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between top-level message rows. Defaults to the selected density; override for LLM event streams or independent rows that need different spacing from density.

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment when the list is shorter than its container. 'bottom' fills free space with a spacer so short conversations sit above the composer; 'top' omits the spacer so messages start at the top. Only affects a non-full list; overflowing lists scroll identically, preserving auto-scroll-to-bottom.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Whether an assistant message is actively streaming. Marks the log aria-busy so screen readers wait and announce the completed message once instead of re-announcing partial text on every token.

components.name: ChatMessageMetadata
components.description: Composable metadata row for chat messages. Renders timestamp, footer content, and delivery status in a single row. Direction reverses for user sender. Omits the row when both slots are omitted or non-rendering scalars and status is omitted.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: Timestamp content: a string or Timestamp component.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content: model info, reaction buttons, copy button.

props.name: status
props.description: Message delivery status. Shows icon + label.

components.name: ChatSendButton
components.description: Circular send/stop toggle button for the chat composer. Place it inside ChatComposer where it reads context automatically: no wiring needed. When streaming starts, the button switches from a primary send icon to a secondary stop icon. Override any context value via props for standalone or custom usage.

props.name: isStopShown
props.description: Whether the stop button is shown. Defaults to context value.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the send button is disabled. Defaults to !canSend from context.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when the user clicks send. Defaults to context onSubmit.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user clicks stop during streaming. Defaults to context onStop.

props.name: sendIcon
props.description: Custom icon for the send state. Defaults to arrowUp from icon registry.

props.name: stopIcon
props.description: Custom icon for the stop state. Defaults to stop from icon registry.

props.name: size
props.description: Button size.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: ChatSystemMessage
components.description: Centered system message for non-sender content like date separators, membership changes, and status notices. It is not a chat bubble; it has no avatar, no alignment, and no sender context. Use the divider variant for temporal breaks and default for inline status updates.

props.name: children
props.description: System message content: factual text or React content such as a date, join/leave notice, or status change. Long default content wraps within the available width.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant. 'default' renders centered text. 'divider' adds horizontal lines on each side via Divider: use for date separators and section breaks.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional caller-provided icon content. Rendered before the message in the default variant; the divider variant currently does not render it. Wrap in Icon for consistent sizing.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: ChatTokenizedText
components.description: Renders a text string with token patterns replaced by inline token content. Wrap any message body inside ChatMessageBubble to turn raw @mentions, #tags, or /commands into styled content. When no non-empty token matches or none are provided, the text renders as-is, so you can use ChatTokenizedText unconditionally on every message.

props.name: children
props.description: The plain text message containing serialized token values. Patterns matching a token's value are replaced with inline token content.

props.name: tokens
props.description: Token definitions using the same type as composer input. Each non-empty value is matched literally. Empty values are ignored. Structured tokens render a Badge, while custom tokens render caller content.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the root text wrapper. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: ChatToolCalls
components.description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface. Use it anywhere an AI agent shows what actions it took.

props.name: calls
props.description: Array of tool call data. Each item has name, status, target, duration, node, additions, deletions, stats, errorMessage, resultDetail, key, and data. status is one of 'pending', 'running', 'complete', or 'error' (defaults to 'complete').

props.name: label
props.description: Custom summary label shown for an expanded group. The translated call count is used when omitted.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Controlled expanded state for the group.

props.name: defaultIsExpanded
props.description: Default expanded state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Callback fired when the expanded state changes.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: CheckboxInput
components.description: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value. Use it for settings like "Enable notifications", terms acceptance, or opt-in choices. For multiple checkboxes in a group, use CheckboxList instead.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the underlying <input> element.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the checkbox (always rendered for accessibility).

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Whether to visually hide the label (still accessible to screen readers).

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed below the label.

props.name: value
props.description: Whether the checkbox is checked, unchecked, or indeterminate.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the checkbox state changes.

props.name: changeAction
props.description: Async action on change. Fires after onChange if not prevented. Shows loading spinner while pending.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Whether the checkbox is in a loading state. Shows spinner and prevents interaction.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the checkbox is disabled.

props.name: htmlName
props.description: The HTML name attribute for the underlying checkbox input, useful for form submissions (submits "on" when checked).

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the checkbox is disabled. With isDisabled, shows a tooltip on hover/keyboard focus and keeps the checkbox focusable via aria-disabled (toggling stays blocked). Use this instead of wrapping a disabled CheckboxInput in Tooltip. Disabled controls swallow the hover events an external Tooltip needs.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the checkbox is read-only. Displays the current state at full opacity but prevents interaction. Unlike `isDisabled`, read-only checkboxes are not visually dimmed.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Whether the field is optional. Mutually exclusive with isRequired.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the checkbox is required. Mutually exclusive with isOptional.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the checkbox. sm for compact layouts, md for default. Under a coarse pointer a labelled checkbox’s target grows toward 44 px through an invisible hit area. It never shrinks below the row and stops at half the gap to a closer neighbour; nothing changes size.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Callback fired when the checkbox receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback fired when the checkbox loses focus.

props.name: labelIcon
props.description: Semantic icon name or custom content displayed before the label text. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: status
props.description: Status indicator. Displays a colored message box below the checkbox and sets aria-invalid for errors.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

components.name: CheckboxList
components.description: Checkbox group container with field integration for label, description, and status.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the checkbox group (always rendered for accessibility).

props.name: children
props.description: CheckboxListItem elements.

props.name: value
props.description: The currently selected values (collection mode).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the selected values change.

props.name: changeAction
props.description: Async action on change with optimistic updates. While the promise is pending, the toggled item shows a spinner inside its checkbox and is marked aria-busy.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Whether to visually hide the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed below the label.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Whether the group is optional. Shows the optional indicator after the group label, unless a surrounding FormLayout already makes fields optional by default.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the group needs at least one checked box. Shows the required indicator after the group label by the same rules as every input field. While no box is checked, the browser blocks submit and moves focus to the first box that is neither disabled nor read-only, with its own message. A disabled or read-only group requires nothing. Show your own error text through status. Mutually exclusive with isOptional.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density for list items.

props.name: hasDividers
props.description: Whether to show dividers between items.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether all checkbox items are disabled.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the group is disabled. Applies to the whole-group disabled state (isDisabled), not per item. With isDisabled, shows a tooltip on hover/keyboard focus and keeps the checkboxes focusable via aria-disabled (toggling stays blocked). Use this instead of wrapping a disabled CheckboxList in Tooltip. Disabled controls swallow the hover events an external Tooltip needs.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether all checkbox items are read-only. Displays the current state at full opacity but prevents interaction. Unlike isDisabled, read-only checkboxes are not visually dimmed.

props.name: status
props.description: Status indicator ({ type, message }).

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

props.name: containerXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the field container (label, control, and status together). No effect inside InputGroup (style the InputGroup instead) or in a `horizontal-labels` FormLayout. Root `xstyle`, `className`, and `style` are not accepted.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class name for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: controlXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the visual control box: the element that paints the border and background and holds icons and end controls. Never the native input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Class name for the visual control box.

props.name: controlStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the visual control box.

components.name: CheckboxListItem
components.description: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a CheckboxList with a value array) or standalone mode (inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value, such as a select-all item). On a touch screen (a coarse primary pointer), a toggleable row is one press target: a touch on the label, the description or the box itself shows the pressed state on the row and its checkbox together. Where the primary pointer is fine, the box keeps its own press.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary text label for the item. Rich labels may contain links or buttons, which keep their own behavior without toggling the item. A ReactNode label names the checkbox from its visible text; pass aria-label only when that text is absent, or include all visible label words in the override.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Plain-text accessible name for the checkbox, replacing the one derived from label. Applied to the checkbox control. Use it when a rich label has no visible text; otherwise the value must retain every visible label word.

props.name: value
props.description: Identity key. Required when the parent CheckboxList has a value array; the item throws without it there.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary content below the label. String or ReactNode. Exposed as the checkbox's accessible description through aria-describedby, so assistive technology can tell it is the explanation for that choice.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content rendered after the label area.

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of the start and end content against the label, passed through to Item unchanged. `first-line` keeps a small mark (a checkbox) level with the first line of a wrapped label. See Item.align.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether this individual item is disabled.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Whether this item is loading. Shows a spinner inside the checkbox and blocks interaction on this item. In collection mode, the toggled item also shows this automatically while the parent changeAction is pending.

props.name: isChecked
props.description: Direct checked state in standalone mode: inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value (for example, a select-all item). Ignored when the parent CheckboxList has a value array.

props.name: onCheck
props.description: Direct check handler in standalone mode: inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value. Ignored when the parent CheckboxList has a value array; that list's onChange receives the change.

components.name: Citation
components.description: Citations display inline references to external sources. Use them to attribute information within AI-generated responses, articles, or anywhere provenance and source links are needed.

props.name: source
props.description: The citation source object containing title, url, an optional image src, and an optional icon node. The url follows the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop; rejected destinations leave the citation visible without navigation. Image src uses separate resource handling.

props.name: number
props.description: The display index for this citation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Display style: a label chip showing the source title or a compact numbered badge.

components.name: ClickableCard
components.description: An interactive card for navigation or action targets. Nested interactive elements work independently.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessibility label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler: fires on card surface only.

props.name: href
props.description: Navigation URL. Plain, new-tab, Cmd/Ctrl-click, and middle-click activation all follow the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the card and removes a link destination; the card keeps its tab stop and is announced as disabled.

props.name: children
props.description: Card content.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding.

props.name: variant
props.description: Background color variant.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting shadow depth. Often raised to signal the whole card is clickable.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width.

props.name: height
props.description: Card height.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum card width.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Code
components.description: Inline code element with a monospace font and muted background. Use it for short code references within prose.

props.name: children
props.description: The inline code content.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Use 'inherit' to take the surrounding text color.

props.name: size
props.description: Set to 'inherit' to take the surrounding font size and line height. Omit it to use the code type-scale size.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the semantic code element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root element. Prefer xstyle for StyleX-optimized styling.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: CodeBlock
