components.description: Fenced code block with syntax highlighting. Use for multi-line code snippets.

props.name: code
props.description: The code string to display.

props.name: language
props.description: Language for syntax highlighting. A string selects a built-in: ts, js, tsx, jsx, json, html, xml, svg, css, scss, less, python, bash/sh/zsh/shell, php, hack, yaml, markdown, c, cpp (c++, cc, cxx, hpp, hh), sql, rust, kotlin, swift, go. Any other language is a value you import on its own and pass here: graphql, java, thrift, objectiveC, toml, powershell, ruby, lua, dockerfile from @astryxdesign/core/CodeBlock/languages/<path> (e.g. languages/graphql, languages/objective-c), or your own made with createCodeLanguage({name, identifiers, tokenize}). A value labels with its name and reflects its first identifier as data-language. Use "plaintext" to disable.

props.name: title
props.description: Filename or label shown in the header bar.

props.name: hasLanguageLabel
props.description: Show the language name in the header bar. Hidden when language is "plaintext".

props.name: hasLineNumbers
props.description: Show a line number gutter.

props.name: startLineNumber
props.description: First line number shown in the gutter. The gutter shows file coordinates (startLineNumber + index) so a code excerpt reads with its real line numbers. highlightLines uses the same file coordinates. Values below 1 clamp to 1.

props.name: highlightLines
props.description: 1-indexed line numbers to highlight, in the same file coordinates as the gutter (see startLineNumber). Out-of-range entries render no highlight.

props.name: isDiff
props.description: Render the code as a unified diff over `language`: lines starting with + are added, - removed, @@ is a hunk header (a `--- `/`+++ ` file-header pair directly before one is a header too), anything else is context. The language label reads `diff` or `<language> diff`. The glyph sits in its own column and the rest of each line keeps syntax highlighting; copy returns the exact source. Markdown ```diff and ```diff-<lang> fences set this.

props.name: hasCopyButton
props.description: Show a copy-to-clipboard button.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Callback after the code is copied.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Your own controls, shown just before Copy: in the header when the block has one, otherwise beside the code in the top inline-end corner, never over it. It never creates a header and never collapses the block. Ghost sm IconButtons match Copy’s size and variant.

props.name: isWrapped
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of enabling horizontal scroll.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height before the block scrolls vertically.

props.name: size
props.description: Text size variant.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the code block. Any CSS width value. 'fit-content' (default) shrinks to longest line. '100%' fills parent width.

props.name: container
props.description: Container presentation style. 'card' (default): border and radius with the muted syntax background for a standalone card look. 'section': no border or radius and a transparent background so the block blends into the card or panel it's embedded in.

props.name: tokenizer
props.type: (code: string, language: string) => Array<{type: string; start: number; end: number}>
props.description: Deprecated: pass language={createCodeLanguage({name, identifiers, tokenize})} with this same function instead. Still works exactly as released and wins over the language; astryx upgrade rewrites static uses.

props.name: syntaxTheme
props.description: Per-instance syntax theme override. Shorthand for wrapping the block in <SyntaxTheme theme={...}>. Accepts a preset from @astryxdesign/core/theme/syntax or a theme created with defineSyntaxTheme(). Defaults to the nearest SyntaxTheme ancestor or the theme-level syntax colors.

props.name: highlightMode
props.description: Syntax highlighting rendering mode.

props.name: isCollapsible
props.description: Allow collapsing the code body into just the header bar. Starts expanded; a visible header becomes clickable when the code exceeds collapsibleThreshold lines. Headerless blocks never collapse, and removing the header expands a previously collapsed block.

props.name: collapsibleThreshold
props.description: Minimum number of lines before the collapse toggle appears. Below this threshold the code block renders normally even when isCollapsible is true.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root code-block element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles. Prefer xstyle for StyleX-optimized styling.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: A primitive that makes any content collapsible: a trigger button toggles visibility of the content area, managing its own state or deferring to a parent CollapsibleGroup.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Content shown in the trigger area (always visible).

props.name: children
props.description: Content that collapses and expands.

props.name: defaultIsOpen
props.description: Default open state for standalone uncontrolled usage. Ignored when value binds the item to a surrounding CollapsibleGroup.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controlled open state for standalone usage. Ignored when value binds the item to a surrounding CollapsibleGroup.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disable the item so its trigger can't be toggled (dimmed, aria-disabled, and out of the tab order). Doesn't collapse an already-open item.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback invoked when standalone open state changes. A surrounding CollapsibleGroup owns grouped state and calls its onChange instead.

props.name: chevronPosition
props.description: Logical position of Collapsible's disclosure chevron. `end` (default) follows the label, pointing down when collapsed and up when expanded. `start` precedes the label, pointing inward toward content when collapsed (mirrored under RTL) and down when expanded. Inside a CollapsibleGroup this defaults to the group's chevronPosition.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifier used for group coordination. When set inside a CollapsibleGroup, the group owns open state and its onChange is the notification callback.

props.name: animatedLayout
props.description: The handle from useAnimatedLayout({containerRef}). With it, opening and closing glides the content after this Collapsible, up to that container, on one shared motion role instead of jumping, and the revealed content and the chevron move on the same motion. Without it, the content after it takes its place at once.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root collapsible element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles. Prefer xstyle for StyleX-optimized styling.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: CollapsibleGroup
components.description: Coordinates multiple Collapsible instances so only one (single mode) or any number (multiple mode) can be open at a time. Renders no wrapper DOM element unless dividers are enabled.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or many items can be open simultaneously.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Default open item(s) for uncontrolled usage. Use a string for single mode and an array for multiple mode.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled open item(s).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback invoked when the set of open items changes.

props.name: hasDividers
props.description: Whether to draw hairline dividers between the group's items. When set, the group renders a wrapper div and items default to 'balanced' density. Pair with bare Collapsible children; Card-wrapped items provide their own separation.

props.name: density
props.description: Row density controlling trigger and content block padding on the group's items. Defaults to 'balanced' when dividers are shown; otherwise items keep their default unpadded look.

props.name: chevronPosition
props.description: Logical position shared by the group's direct Collapsible items. `end` is the default trailing indicator; `start` is a leading disclosure arrow that points inward when collapsed (mirrored under RTL) and down when expanded. An individual Collapsible can still override it.

props.name: children
props.description: Collapsible instances to coordinate.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the group wrapper when hasDividers renders one.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the group wrapper when hasDividers renders one. Must be a stylex.create() value.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the group wrapper when hasDividers renders one. Prefer xstyle for styling.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the group wrapper when hasDividers renders one. Prefer xstyle for StyleX-optimized styling.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector forwarded to the group wrapper when hasDividers renders one.

props.name: emptySearchText

components.name: CommandPaletteEmpty

props.name: xstyle

components.name: ContextMenu

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Custom menu width.

props.name: size

props.name: label

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: presentation

props.name: isDisabled

props.description: Label text.

props.name: isLabelHidden

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text displayed below the label.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Show an "(optional)" indicator next to the label.

props.name: isRequired

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal dialog using the native <dialog> element. Modal and inline content starts with theme body text defaults. Ancestor surface/group membership ends as a whole, including group-owned state. Explicit props and unrelated contexts remain unchanged. Place intentional groups and complete required providers inside the dialog. With reduced motion the dialog never slides or scales in: on a touch screen it fades in, in 200 ms or less, and with a mouse it appears at once. On a phone or tablet (a coarse primary pointer), a tap or a drag that lands while the dialog is still entering reaches nothing, and the dialog finishes entering; keys and assistive technology stay live, and a mouse or a trackpad still clicks: at once when it was the last pointer used, otherwise once it moves.

props.description: Whether the dialog is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when dialog visibility changes.

props.name: children
props.description: Dialog content.

props.description: Close button callback (no button if omitted).

props.description: Content after the title, before close button.

props.description: Selects compensation axes for the end-content slot. Omit to preserve automatic close-action compensation.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer is open. Fully controlled; pair with onOpenChange.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer requests an open-state change. props.name: children
props.description: Drawer content, rendered inside a full-height scrollable area. Compose your own header/body/footer; an element with data-autofocus is focused on open. Children stay mounted during the exit animation; keep the last-selected item rendered instead of nulling content on close.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the drawer slides from: 'end' is right in LTR (the inspector convention), 'start' is left. Inline axis only; for a bottom sheet use BottomSheet.

props.name: width

props.name: experimental
props.description: Experimental options: anything in this object may change or be removed in a patch release, and omitting it keeps the stable behavior. isFullWidthOnMobile (default false) covers the full viewport width below the 640px mobile breakpoint instead of preserving the default 56px reveal of the page behind, which makes the drawer read as an overlay, not a navigation.

props.name: hasScrim

props.name: purpose

A non-modal drawer has no scrim, so form and info behave the same.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Action menu with a trigger button and anchored, bottom-sheet, or adaptive presentation.

props.name: button
props.description: Props for the trigger button (Button props except onClick). Mutually exclusive with `renderTrigger`.

props.name: renderTrigger
props.description: Render the control the menu hangs off — an IconButton, a chip, an avatar, a list row — instead of the built-in Button. Spread the given props onto it: they carry the press model (a mouse opens on press-down, a held finger opens with the finger down), the keyboard opens, the toggle click, and `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`/`id`; the menu is then named by that control through `aria-labelledby`. Mutually exclusive with `button`.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of menu entries. Each entry is one of: an action item `{label, onClick?, href?, target?, rel?, icon?, description?, endContent?, isDisabled?, variant?, hasCloseOnSelect?, id?}` (`href` makes the row a real link, so a modified click keeps the browser's meaning; variant `"destructive"` renders it in the error color; `endContent` holds trailing content such as a keyboard-shortcut hint; `id` is the row's stable React key, needed only when the array reorders or filters), a divider `{type: "divider"}`, or a section `{type: "section", title?, id?, items: [...action items]}`.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Presentation surface for data-driven items. 'popover' stays anchored, 'bottom-sheet' always renders the actions in a modal BottomSheet, and 'adaptive' uses a BottomSheet on compact coarse-pointer layouts while remaining anchored elsewhere. Compound children currently support popover only. Omitted, the menu is anchored, and under a finger, on every device, the finger that opened it picks a row only after moving 10 px. Pass 'popover' to keep the pointer behavior on every device, the settle rule included.

props.name: isMenuOpen
props.description: Controlled open state for the menu. Mounting with true renders the menu open without moving focus into it; focus moves to the first item only when the menu opens after mount.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the open state changes.

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Minimum width for the popover presentation. Length values may grow for content; intrinsic and CSS-wide keywords select the preferred inline size. Every form is capped to the available viewport space. Defaults to matching the trigger width up to that cap.

props.name: menuMaxHeight
props.description: Maximum height in pixels for the popover presentation, for a menu that must fit its rows. Lifts the default 300px cap; the viewport still bounds it.

props.name: header
props.description: Content above the rows and outside the menu itself — a filter field, a toggle. A menu holds only its rows, so a control that is not a row goes here or in `footer`, never among the rows. It keeps its own keys and presses. With a header or footer the popover is a modal dialog around the menu: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the header, the menu and the footer and wrap at either end, and Escape closes. The bottom sheet shows it above the actions.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content below the rows and outside the menu itself — a "Create" button. Tab from the menu moves into it, and Tab past its last control wraps to the start of the dialog (see `header`). The bottom sheet shows it below the actions.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popover placement relative to the trigger. Ignored by the bottom-sheet presentation. Logical: start/end resolve against the menu's own inherited direction (RTL mirrors).

props.name: alignment
props.description: Popover alignment along the placement axis. Ignored by the bottom-sheet presentation. Logical: start/end follow the menu's own inherited direction (RTL mirrors).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback fired for accepted trigger activation. The trailing click from the same press that light-dismissed the menu is ignored.

props.name: hasChevron
props.description: Whether to show a chevron icon on the trigger button. Set to false for icon-only triggers.

props.name: children
props.description: Compound-mode menu content: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuDivider, DropdownMenuSubMenu (a flyout on a laptop, a drilled-in view with a Back row on a phone), and the selectable items. Mutually exclusive with `items`.

components.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
components.description: A checkable menu item (role="menuitemcheckbox") that toggles an independent boolean. Use for on/off options inside a DropdownMenu; for a one-of-N choice use DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label text identifying the item.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text displayed below the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: value
props.description: Whether the item is checked. Controlled; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired with the next checked state when the item is toggled.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the item is disabled. A disabled item stays in the accessibility tree as disabled (aria-disabled) but takes no focus: the arrow keys, typeahead, and the pointer highlight skip it, and activation is blocked.

props.name: hasCloseOnSelect
props.description: Whether toggling the item closes the menu. Checkbox items default to staying open so several can be toggled in a single session.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitemcheckbox". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content to render after the label and description, such as a keyboard shortcut hint or badge.

components.name: DropdownMenuDivider
components.description: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "divider"}` entry in `items`; both modes render this component, so they look and theme identically. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the separator; its role and orientation stay component-owned.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles applied after the menu spacing. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: DropdownMenuGroup
components.description: A group of rows in a compound menu. A visible title names role="group" through aria-labelledby; an omitted title leaves the group unnamed. The heading is not a menuitem, so arrow keys and typeahead skip it. Keep title content non-interactive and place controls in DropdownMenu header or footer. The data-driven equivalent is the `{type: "section", title, items}` entry in `items`; both forms share the heading treatment and theme target. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the group element; its role, and its name while it has a title, stay component-owned.

props.name: title
props.description: Non-interactive heading content shown above the rows and used as the group's accessible name. Omit for an unnamed group; place controls in DropdownMenu header or footer.

props.name: children
props.description: The grouped rows: DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, or DropdownMenuSubMenu.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles applied to the role="group" wrapper. Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name applied to the role="group" wrapper.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the role="group" wrapper.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the role="group" wrapper.

components.name: DropdownMenuItem
components.description: One action or destination row in the pointer presentation of DropdownMenu. The parent menu owns keyboard navigation; the row owns activation, disabled state, destination behavior, content layout, and its theme target. Supported host attributes, DOM handlers, className, style, xstyle, and ref reach or compose on the role="menuitem" root.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label text.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text displayed below the label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Callback when the item is selected. A keyboard activation arrives as a synthesized click carrying the key's modifiers. On a row with `href` it runs before the browser navigates and is skipped for a modified click (⌘, Ctrl, Shift, Alt, middle button), which is left to the browser.

props.name: href
props.description: Address the row navigates to. The row then renders as a real anchor with role="menuitem" (through LinkProvider), so a modified click or a middle click keeps the browser's meaning — a new tab — instead of running onClick.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target. Only used with href.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship. noopener noreferrer is added for target="_blank". Only used with href.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the row is unavailable. Disabled rows expose aria-disabled, remove link destinations, and suppress activation.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Non-interactive content rendered after the label and description.

props.name: hasCloseOnSelect
props.description: Whether activating the item closes the menu. Set false for an action that reports its result on the item itself.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant. 'destructive' renders the label, description, and icon in the error color for dangerous actions (e.g. Delete).

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitem". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay.

components.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
components.description: A controlled, named single-select group of DropdownMenuRadioItem children (role="group" of menuitemradio). Owns value propagation, close policy, root composition, and the menu inter-item gap; the parent DropdownMenu owns keyboard navigation.

props.name: value
props.description: The currently selected value in the group. Pass undefined when nothing is selected yet.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the selected value changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, applied as aria-label so screen readers announce the radios as a named set, e.g. "Sort by". Required even when aria-labelledby (via base props) points to visible text; that visible reference becomes the computed name while label remains the fallback.

props.name: hasCloseOnSelect
props.description: Whether selecting a value closes the menu. Radio items default to closing on selection (a single-choice commit).

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the role="group" root.

props.name: children
props.description: The DropdownMenuRadioItems that make up the group.

components.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
components.description: A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio"). Must be used inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this item represents within its group. The group's value matches against this to determine the checked state.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label text identifying the option.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text displayed below the label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether this individual radio item is disabled. A disabled item stays in the accessibility tree as disabled (aria-disabled) but takes no focus: the arrow keys, typeahead, and the pointer highlight skip it, and selection is blocked.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content to render after the label and description, such as a badge or metadata.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitemradio". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay.

components.name: DropdownMenuSubMenu
components.description: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items. The row adopts DropdownMenuItem semantics (label / icon / description / isDisabled); its children become the flyout content. Opens inline-end with viewport auto-flip; Right/Enter/Space opens and focuses the first item, Left/Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (Right/Left swap in RTL). On a phone (a coarse pointer, decided when the menu opened) the row drills in instead: its rows replace the menu's rows in the same box, led by a Back row named "Back to <parent>", and Back, Escape or ArrowLeft return to the row. Host attributes and DOM event handlers (aria-*, data-*, id) reach the trigger row, the element carrying role="menuitem" and aria-haspopup="menu"; a caller's handlers run after the row's own, except for the keys that open the flyout (the open arrow, Enter, Space) and a click on a disabled row. For data-driven menus, give a menu item a nested `items` array instead of using this component directly.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label text for the trigger row.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text displayed below the label.

props.name: children
props.description: The flyout menu items: the same components used at the top level (DropdownMenuItem, nested DropdownMenuSubMenu, selectable items).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: A disabled submenu renders its trigger row but never opens the flyout.

props.name: hasSpinner
props.description: Show a spinner in place of the caret, e.g. while a lazy submenu's children are loading.

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Minimum flyout width. The flyout may grow for its content, but it is capped to the available viewport space. Defaults to intrinsic sizing (min 160px).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the flyout opens or closes.

props.name: presentation
props.description: How the sub-menu shows its rows. 'flyout' opens them beside the row; 'drill-in' replaces the menu's rows with them and a Back row, in the same box; 'adaptive' drills in when a finger opened the menu (a coarse pointer, decided when the menu opened) and flies out otherwise.

props.name: header
props.description: Content above the sub-menu's rows and outside its menu, a field that filters them, say. It keeps its own keys and presses. With a header or footer the sub-menu's surface (the flyout, or the drilled-in view on a phone) is a modal dialog named by the row, beside the menu rather than inside it: the row says aria-haspopup="dialog", Tab and Shift+Tab move through the header, the rows and the footer and wrap, Escape returns to the row, and a pointer leaving the flyout closes it only once focus leaves too. A ContextMenu does not show it.

props.name: footer
props.description: Content below the sub-menu's rows and outside its menu, a door to where the options are managed, say. Same rules as header.

props.name: menuDataTestId
props.description: Test id for the sub-menu's own role="menu" element: the flyout, or the drilled-in list on a phone. The trigger row takes data-testid.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the trigger row. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the trigger row, the element carrying role="menuitem" and aria-haspopup="menu" ("dialog" with a header or footer).

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data. Use it for empty lists, zero search results, first-time setups, or cleared inboxes. Always include a title and a next step so the user is not stuck.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary message rendered as the configured heading level inside the empty state.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional secondary text providing additional context below the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon or illustration displayed above the title; rendered as decorative (aria-hidden="true").

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional action buttons displayed below the description, laid out horizontally by default and stacked vertically when isCompact is true.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Controls only the rendered HTML heading tag (h1-h6) so the title fits the document outline. This is a semantic change for accessibility and does not change the visual size of the title, which stays fixed regardless of level.

props.name: isCompact
props.description: Enables the compact variant with reduced spacing for constrained content areas.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Field
components.description: Low-level form field wrapper for custom controls that need a label, description, and optional/required indicators.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the field (always rendered for accessibility).

props.name: inputID
props.description: ID for the input element (used for the label htmlFor attribute).

props.name: labelID
props.description: ID applied to the label element itself for group accessibility.

props.name: isGroupLabel
props.description: Renders the label as a span for control groups (radiogroup, checkbox list).

props.name: children
props.description: The input or control to render.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label (still accessible to screen readers).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the associated input is disabled. Propagates disabled styling to the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed between the label and input.

props.name: descriptionID
props.description: ID for the description element (use for aria-describedby on the input).

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Whether the field is optional (mutually exclusive with isRequired).

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the field is required (mutually exclusive with isOptional).

props.name: labelIcon
props.description: Icon to display before the label text. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text to display in an info icon at the end of the label. Hover shows it; on a touch screen a tap on the icon opens it without focusing the field, while a mouse click on the icon focuses the field like the rest of the label.

props.name: status
props.description: Status indicator with type and optional message. When message is set, displays a colored status box. messageID is for wiring aria-describedby on the input.

props.name: statusVariant
props.description: How status feedback is placed. Attached overlaps an eligible opaque, bordered, fixed-height control; detached renders a message below custom or non-bordered controls; tooltip leaves the visible affordance to the wrapped input and announces its message without a FieldStatus box.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned. Prefer this over setting width via xstyle/className/style, which only size the inner control box. Without a width, a row can shrink the whole field below the natural width of its control, so filter bars shrink instead of overflowing.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root element.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name(s) appended to the root element. Prefer xstyle for StyleX deduplication.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the root element. Takes priority over StyleX inline styles.

components.name: FieldLabel
components.description: Standalone label group for one control or a caller-labelled group, with optional supporting text, optionality indicators, icon, and tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text, always rendered for accessibility.

props.name: inputID
props.description: ID of the input this label is for.

props.name: labelID
props.description: ID applied to the label element itself. Use it with `aria-labelledby` when `isGroupLabel` is true.

props.name: isGroupLabel
props.description: Render a span that can name a group instead of a native label for one control.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label and description while keeping both available to assistive technology.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Use disabled label presentation for the associated control.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Show the localized optional indicator unless it matches FormLayout's default optionality.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Show the localized required indicator unless it matches FormLayout's default optionality.

props.name: labelIcon
props.description: Icon or rendered icon content before the label text. See `astryx docs icons` for semantic names.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text for the info icon after the label. Hover shows it; on a touch screen a tap on the icon opens it without focusing the field or toggling the control, while a mouse click on the icon activates the control like the rest of the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting content displayed below the label and kept separate from the control's accessible name.

props.name: descriptionID
props.description: ID applied to the supporting description for caller-owned `aria-describedby` wiring.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the label element. Group mode currently renders a span.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles applied to the label element after its base and state styles.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name appended to the label element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the label element after StyleX inline styles.

components.name: FieldStatus
components.description: Status message component for form field validation feedback. Messages are announced to screen readers through persistent live regions (assertive for errors, polite otherwise), so conditional mounting is safe.

props.name: type
props.description: Status type.

props.name: message
props.description: Status message text.

props.name: id
props.description: ID for aria-describedby association.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant: attached overlaps the input, detached floats below.

components.name: FileInput
components.description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support. Use it for single or multiple file selection with built-in validation for file type, size, and count. Pair with validation status for upload feedback.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the file input.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected file(s). Controlled component.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when files are selected or removed.

props.name: changeAction
props.description: Async change action (React 19 transitions pattern). Use for immediate upload on file selection.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted file types. Uses the HTML accept attribute format (e.g. "image/*", ".pdf,.doc").

props.name: isMultiple
props.description: Whether multiple files can be selected. When true, value and onChange use File[] instead of File.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum file size in bytes. Files exceeding this are rejected with an error status.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Maximum number of files (only applies when isMultiple is true).

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed between the label and input.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Displays an "Optional" indicator next to the label. Mutually exclusive with isRequired.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Displays a "Required" indicator next to the label and adds a screen-reader-only "Required" description to the trigger (assistive tech does not reliably announce aria-required on the trigger). Mutually exclusive with isOptional.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the input, preventing interaction and dimming the element.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the input is disabled. With isDisabled, shows a tooltip on hover/keyboard focus and keeps the trigger focusable via aria-disabled (opening the file picker stays blocked). Use this instead of wrapping a disabled FileInput in Tooltip; disabled controls swallow the hover events an external Tooltip needs.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Puts the input in a loading state, showing a spinner and setting aria-busy.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no file is selected.

props.name: mode
props.description: Visual mode. 'input' is a compact inline style; 'dropzone' is a larger area with drag-and-drop support.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status: applies a colored border. If message is provided, displays a floating message below the input. Error type also sets aria-invalid.

props.name: statusVariant
props.description: How the status message is placed relative to the input. attached overlaps directly below the input (bordered treatment); detached floats below as a separate element with spacing; tooltip hides the message box and surfaces it in a tooltip on the status icon. Dropzone mode does not support attached: use detached or tooltip. From the next minor release, a dropzone resolves attached to detached and defaults to it.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text displayed in an info icon at the end of the label.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

props.name: containerXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the field container (label, control, and status together). No effect inside InputGroup (style the InputGroup instead) or in a `horizontal-labels` FormLayout. Root `xstyle`, `className`, and `style` are not accepted.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class name for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: controlXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the visual control box: the element that paints the border and background and holds icons and end controls. Never the native input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Class name for the visual control box.

props.name: controlStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the visual control box.

components.name: FormLayout
components.description: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction. FormLayout handles where fields go, not state or submission. Wrap it in a <form> for that. Supports vertical (default), horizontal, and horizontal-labels directions, and can be nested to mix them.

props.name: direction
props.description: Controls field arrangement. Vertical stacks top-to-bottom, horizontal uses one fractional grid track per field in logical inline order, and horizontal-labels uses CSS Grid with labels beside inputs on the inline-start side (collapsing to vertical when the viewport is <=480px).

props.name: defaultOptionality
props.description: The state the form treats as its default, so only the exception shows an optional/required indicator. With "optional", only fields marked isRequired show an indicator; with "required", only fields marked isOptional do. A field that restates the default shows nothing. Under "required" the unmarked fields also expose aria-required so screen readers match the visual default; aria-required only, never the native required attribute. CheckboxInput, Switch and CheckboxList are the exception: an unchecked box, an off switch or an empty group is an answer, so they take no required state from the default. A CheckboxInput or Switch is required only through its own isRequired. Leave unset for today's per-field behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Form fields to arrange. Accepts Astryx inputs (TextInput, Selector, etc.) and Field-wrapped custom controls.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Grid container with fixed or responsive columns; `{minWidth, max}` reflows, a number never does.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column configuration. A number creates exactly N `1fr` tracks at every width and never reflows (e.g. `columns={3}`); a child's minimum content may widen its track. For columns that reflow on small screens, use `{minWidth, max}`. Use an object for responsive columns: `minWidth` sets the minimum column width in px, `repeat` controls track behavior (`"fill"` preserves empty tracks for consistent widths, `"fit"` collapses empty tracks so items stretch; defaults to `"fill"`), and `max` caps the maximum number of columns.

props.name: width
props.description: Container width. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: height
props.description: Container height. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum container width. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum container height. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between all items.

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Row spacing; overrides `gap` for the row axis.

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Column spacing; overrides `gap` for the column axis.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each implicit row track in pixels. Pair with `GridSpan rows={N}` for masonry-style layouts.

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of items (`align-items`). Unset leaves the browser default, `normal`, which stretches items that have no natural size or aspect ratio.

props.name: justify
props.description: Horizontal alignment of items (`justify-items`). Unset leaves the browser default, `normal`, which stretches items that have no natural size or aspect ratio.

props.name: children
props.description: Grid content.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: GridSpan
components.description: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns to span; use `'full'` to span all explicit columns.

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows to span.

props.name: children
props.description: Content.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles applied to the span wrapper. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name applied to the span wrapper.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the span wrapper. When `columns` or `rows` is set, its `grid-column` or `grid-row` replaces the same property in `style`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the span wrapper.

components.name: Heading
components.description: Semantic heading component that renders h1-h6 elements with themed styling, themed sizing via type scale tokens, and line-clamp truncation.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Determines the semantic HTML element (h1-h6) and the visual styling from the theme (unless `type` is set).

props.name: type
props.description: Display type variant. Overrides the visual styling from `level` with display-scale sizing (larger, lighter weight, tighter line-height). Themes may add custom visual types. The `level` still determines the HTML element for accessibility. Use for hero banners, marketing headlines, and data callouts.

props.name: weight
props.description: Explicit font-weight override. Wins over the selected visual type or heading-level default.

props.name: children
props.description: Heading content.

props.name: accessibilityLevel
props.description: Accessibility level override. When set and different from `level`, applies `aria-level` so the document outline differs from the visual style.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color. Themes may add custom colors.

props.name: display
props.description: Display type. Silently overridden to 'block' when maxLines > 0 or hasCapsize is true.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Maximum lines before truncation. 0 means no truncation. When set, shows a tooltip on hover if content is truncated.

props.name: hasTruncateTooltip
props.description: Controls tooltip behavior for truncated text. true shows the tooltip at the default position, false disables it, or a placement string ('above' | 'below' | 'start' | 'end') sets a specific position.

props.name: wordBreak
props.description: Word break behavior when truncating. Defaults to 'break-all' for single-line truncation, 'break-word' otherwise. Without truncation, a token longer than its line (a URL, an ID) wraps (`overflow-wrap: break-word`), so in ordinary flow text does not make the page scroll sideways. Inside a flex row, give the flex child `min-width: 0` so it can shrink. A container you style with `overflow-wrap: anywhere` does not reach this text; Astryx's own containers pass their wrap through.

props.name: textWrap
props.description: Text wrapping behavior.

props.name: justify
props.description: Text alignment (justification). Uses logical values (start/end) for i18n/RTL compatibility.

props.name: hasCapsize
props.description: Enable optical alignment using text-box-trim. Forces block display.

props.name: hasStrikethrough
props.description: Apply strikethrough text decoration.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id attribute.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles applied to the heading element. Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name applied to the heading element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the heading element. When `maxLines` is above 1, its line clamp replaces any `WebkitLineClamp` in `style`.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the heading element.

components.name: HoverCard
components.description: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element. Use it for profile cards, link summaries, or inline definitions where the user needs more context without navigating away.

components.name: Icon
components.description: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts. They improve scannability and reinforce meaning alongside text. Supports both direct SVG components and semantic icon names that adapt to the active theme.

props.name: icon
props.description: Semantic icon name or SVG component. Valid semantic names: close, chevronDown, chevronLeft, chevronRight, chevronsLeft, chevronsRight, check, success, error, warning, info, calendar, clock, externalLink, menu, moreHorizontal, search, upload, arrowUp, arrowDown, arrowsUpDown, funnel, eyeSlash, viewColumns, copy, checkDouble, wrench, stop, microphone. A namespaced key such as `richtext:bold` names a glyph that one component or library registers, and a theme can replace it by key; a namespaced key that nothing registers renders nothing. For any icon not in this list, pass an SVG component directly (e.g. import from lucide-react or @heroicons/react). Note: this prop is called `icon`, not `name`.

props.name: color
props.description: Color variant mapped to Astryx icon color tokens. Semantic values (primary through warning) follow the role, and inherit uses the surrounding text color. On the web, Icon also accepts the palette values blue, red, green, gray, cyan, teal, yellow, orange, pink, and purple, which pick a non-semantic hue.

props.name: size
props.description: Icon size. xsm, sm, md, and lg are 12, 16, 20, and 24px at a 16px root and scale with the root font size; a theme sets a size's glyph dimension with width and height, in px or rem, on components.icon['size:sm'] (and the other sizes). An explicit value wins. When omitted, Icon uses the nearest default supplied by an owning Astryx component for its icon slot, then falls back to md when no contextual default exists.

props.name: variant
props.description: Requests the active theme's alternate artwork for a semantic icon name, such as 'filled'. Names come from IconVariantMap, which an application augments from @astryxdesign/core/Icon; Astryx defines none. The theme's icon entry receives the variant only when the active theme lists it in iconVariants (and, for an entry the theme inherited, the theme that defined the entry lists it too); otherwise it draws its normal artwork. Ignored by an icon component passed directly. Selects artwork only: it is not written to the DOM and has no theming selector.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a MEANINGFUL, standalone icon (a status glyph or icon-only indicator with no adjacent text). Setting it exposes the icon to screen readers as role="img" with this text as the accessible name (aria-label) and removes the default aria-hidden. Omit it (default) for decorative icons and the icon stays hidden from assistive tech (aria-hidden="true"). This is the accessible-name / alt-text prop for icons: one prop instead of manually setting aria-label + role + aria-hidden. An empty string is treated as decorative. Do not set it when an interactive parent (Button, IconButton, link) already names the control.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for customization (color, size, opacity). Folded into the icon's own stylex.props() call so it composes with the base color/size styles. Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name added to the rendered glyph, beside the astryx-icon target class.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles merged onto the rendered glyph after Icon's own size and color styles.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the rendered SVG element, for an icon component and for a semantic or namespaced name. For a name, it is the <svg> inside the wrapper, or null when the resolved glyph has no <svg>.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text. Use IconButton in toolbars, table rows, and compact UI where space is tight and the icon is universally understood.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Used as aria-label (not rendered as visible text).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon element rendered inside the button. An Astryx Icon with no explicit size defaults to sm for sm/md buttons and md for lg buttons.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: elevation
props.description: Resting shadow depth. The most common FAB shape is an icon-only button, so raise it with `low`/`med`/`high` for a floating action button. `none` is the default flat button.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner and blocks re-activation while staying focusable (aria-busy + aria-disabled, not native disabled).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the button. When a tooltip is present, uses aria-disabled instead of native disabled so the button stays focusable.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text shown on hover and keyboard focus. It also describes the button, unless it repeats the button's accessible name.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Standard click handler.

props.name: clickAction
props.description: Async click handler with automatic loading state.

props.name: isInterruptible
props.description: Keep the button clickable while a clickAction is pending: the spinner and aria-busy still show, but the button is not disabled and the action is not deduped, so a re-click lands and interrupts the in-flight action with a fresh one. Use it for interruptible actions, not fire-once actions (submit, save, pay).

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the button. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is. Without it the button keeps its icon-only aspect, square by default; with it the button takes that width.

props.name: type
props.description: HTML button type attribute.

props.name: name
props.description: HTML name attribute for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: HTML value attribute for form submission.

props.name: form
props.description: Associates the button with a form element by ID.

props.name: href
props.description: When provided, renders the button as a link element (<a> or custom link component). A disabled IconButton still renders a <button>.

props.name: as
props.description: Custom link component to use when href is provided (e.g. Next.js Link).

props.name: target
props.description: HTML target attribute when rendered as a link (e.g. "_blank").

props.name: rel
props.description: HTML rel attribute when rendered as a link (e.g. "noopener noreferrer").

components.name: Indicator
components.description: Decorative control visuals: the mark on a chosen option, the box a checkbox draws, the circle a radio draws. Rendered by Selector, CheckboxInput, RadioList, and menu selection rows. Replace one by name through defineTheme({indicators}) and every component drawing it follows.

components.name: InfoTip
components.description: An info icon that reveals help: a small "i" button. Hover and keyboard focus preview the help, and a click, tap, Enter, or Space pins it open until Escape, a second press, a press outside, or focus leaving. Use it next to labels, values, and metrics for permission notes, metric definitions, and field help. Its value over hand-composing Icon inside Tooltip is the pre-wired accessible trigger: a real button with an aria-label, Tab-reachable, tooltip on hover AND focus AND tap, and Escape dismissal. It follows the toggletip pattern: the button reports `aria-expanded="true"` while the help is pinned, and a screen reader hears the help once when it pins.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display in the tooltip. Typically short, non-interactive text. Mirrors Tooltip's content prop.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger button. Defaults to the translated "More information".

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the info icon (12px, 16px, 20px, 24px). Maps 1:1 to Icon sizes.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: Groups an input with prefix and suffix addons in one connected row. A focused member stays above its neighbours, so its focus ring shows in full.

props.name: children
props.description: InputGroupText, Button addons, and compatible input children: TextInput, NumberInput, TimeInput, DateInput, Typeahead, Selector, or MultiSelector.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the group.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text between label and input group.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disable the entire group.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Show the "Optional" indicator after the label.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Mark the field as required.

props.name: size
props.description: Default size for inputs in the group.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status. Its message shows below the group. The group border does not change; a theme can style the row from `data-status`.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text at the end of the label.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector.

components.name: InputGroupText
components.description: A prefix or suffix text element rendered inside InputGroup. Displays text or icons.

props.name: children
props.description: Text or icon content.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name(s).

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the text cell element.

components.name: InternationalizationProvider
components.description: Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. Astryx components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context. If no provider is present, components fall back to the shipped English defaults.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 language tag for the active locale (e.g. "en", "pt", "pt-BR", "zh-Hans"). Regional tags fall back to their base language, then to the shipped "en" catalog.

props.name: messages
props.description: Optional map of BCP 47 tag to a rich or generated runtime catalog. Import compact shipped catalogs from `@astryxdesign/core/locales/*.generated.js`; the shipped "en" catalog is always available and does not need to be listed here.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Sparse per-locale key overrides applied on top of shipped defaults. Overrides are locale-keyed so a runtime locale swap picks up the correct set.

props.name: dir
props.description: Explicit text-direction override for the context. When omitted, direction is derived from `locale` via `Intl.Locale.getTextInfo()`. This sets the direction Astryx reads, but it does NOT set the DOM `dir` attribute; you must set `dir` on `<html>` (or a wrapping element) yourself, since Astryx components mirror layout and directional icons from the DOM `dir`, not from this prop. Set both to the same value and keep them in sync.

props.name: calendar
props.description: Calendar system of the subtree, such as 'persian', 'hebrew', or 'buddhist'. `Calendar`, `DateInput`, `DateRangeInput`, and `DateTimeInput` show it, and Timestamp, PowerSearch, and Lab's Schedule write their dates in it. When omitted, the calendar is Gregorian: a locale never selects it, neither by its default calendar nor by a `-u-ca-` keyword. A component's own `calendar` prop takes precedence. Values stay Gregorian ISO dates. Calendars other than gregory, iso8601, buddhist, roc, and japanese need `Temporal`; the context keeps the requested calendar, and where the runtime lacks `Temporal`, these components show Gregorian dates and warn in development. Load a polyfill such as `temporal-polyfill/full/global` on the server and in the browser.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render with the internationalization provider.

components.name: Item
components.description: A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across Astryx. Use it wherever you need a structured row: dropdown menus, selectors, contact lists, notifications, file browsers, and activity feeds.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges. Use Kbd in tooltips, menus, and help text to show key combinations.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keyboard shortcut string. Use "+" to separate keys. Special keys: mod (Cmd on Mac), ctrl, alt, shift, enter, backspace, escape, tab, up, down, left, right, plus. Aliases: esc for escape and return for enter.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; className is provided for integration with non-StyleX systems.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; inline styles bypass StyleX optimization.

components.name: Layer
components.description: Layer utilities provide the app-level provider used by overlay systems. Use LayerProvider at the app root for toast/layer configuration; use higher-level Popover, HoverCard, or Tooltip APIs for most overlay UI. Rendered layer content, not the provider’s application subtree, uses theme body text defaults and exits ancestor surface/group membership. Establish intentional groups and complete required providers inside each layer. Every anchored layer keeps a gutter from each viewport edge — the spacing-4 step or the device safe-area inset, whichever is larger — and is capped to the viewport, never to the room beside its trigger: an explicit width renders at its size, flips when it does not fit beside the trigger, and slides into view when it fits on neither side. An app that floats a persistent bar over a viewport edge declares it once as inset on LayerProvider (blockStart, blockEnd, inlineStart, inlineEnd); each edge adds to that edge’s gutter for every anchored layer and moves the toast viewport by the same amount, and defaults to zero. The inset is app configuration, not a theme value.

components.name: Layout
components.description: General five-slot layout primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions.

props.name: content
props.description: Content slot (center). Accepts any ReactNode; use LayoutContent when a content region is needed. Children passed to `<Layout>` render here too: `<Layout>{main}</Layout>` is shorthand for `<Layout content={main} />`.

props.name: header
props.description: Header slot. Accepts any ReactNode; use LayoutHeader when a header region is needed.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer slot. Accepts any ReactNode; use LayoutFooter when a footer region is needed.

props.name: start
props.description: Logical-start slot (left in LTR). Accepts any ReactNode; use LayoutPanel when a panel region is needed.

props.name: end
props.description: Logical-end slot (right in LTR). Accepts any ReactNode; use LayoutPanel when a panel region is needed.

props.name: height
props.description: Height behavior: fill the container or grow with content.

props.name: contentWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the aligned content within each slot (header, content, footer, panels), centered when narrower than the available space. Without panels, LayoutContent spans the available width so its scrollbar stays at the outer edge while its children align internally to contentWidth. With exactly one panel, the panel stays aligned to the contentWidth frame while LayoutContent extends to the opposite open edge. With both panels, contentWidth includes the complete middle composition. Percentage widths—including percentage-bearing calc(), min(), max(), and clamp() values—and intrinsic widths, plus bare var(...) values, retain the constrained composition; use calc(var(...)) for a variable guaranteed to resolve to a length. Dividers stay full-bleed. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is (e.g. `60ch`). Common page widths: 640 for forms, settings, and text-focused pages; 960 for content pages and wider layouts.

props.name: padding
props.description: Padding at the layout's outer edges using the spacing scale. Applies to this Layout's own header, footer, panels, and content. A nested Layout does not inherit it: without `padding`, its regions use the enclosing Card, Section, or Dialog padding, or the default inset (spacing 4). That keeps a page Layout inside AppShell inset even though AppShell's own regions are full bleed.

props.name: defaultHasDividers
props.description: Default divider visibility for LayoutHeader and LayoutFooter children. Headers and footers that don't pass `hasDivider` use this value; when unset, nested layouts inherit from their parent context.

components.name: LayoutContent
components.description: Scrollable main content area.

props.name: children
props.description: Content.

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding using the spacing scale. Overrides the default padding from the layout container.

props.name: isScrollable
props.description: Enable scrollable overflow. With arithmetic contentWidth values, the scrollport spans through every open side while context-aware insets keep children aligned.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the landmark element. While the region scrolls, it also names the scrolling region, which otherwise takes a translated "Content".

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA landmark role.

components.name: LayoutFooter
components.description: Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.

props.name: children
props.description: Footer content.

props.name: hasDivider
props.description: Border at top edge.

props.name: height
props.description: Footer height. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the landmark element.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA landmark role.

components.name: LayoutHeader
components.description: Top bar for page titles, app bars, and toolbars.

props.name: children
props.description: Header content.

props.name: hasDivider
props.description: Border at bottom edge.

props.name: height
props.description: Header height. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the landmark element.

props.name: paddingBlockEnd
props.description: Block-end (bottom) padding, using the spacing scale. Overrides padding on that edge only; paddingBlockEnd={0} docks the last child on the header bottom edge.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA landmark role.

components.name: LayoutPanel
components.description: Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel content.

props.name: hasDivider
props.description: Border on the appropriate edge.

props.name: padding
props.description: Internal padding using the spacing scale. Overrides the default padding from the layout container.

props.name: isScrollable
props.description: Enable scrollable overflow.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the landmark element. While the region scrolls, it also names the scrolling region, which otherwise takes a translated "Content".

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA landmark role.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the panel. Numbers are treated as pixels, strings are used as-is. Ignored when resizable is provided; the hook controls width. Beside a ResizeHandle given a useResizable region's props, a panel at width={region.size} is inert while the region is collapsed, and focus inside it moves to the handle as it collapses.

props.name: resizable
props.description: The output of useResizable(), or its props. When provided, the hook drives the panel width and a ResizeHandle should be placed adjacent to the panel. Carries the region's axis ('horizontal' | 'vertical'), which must match the adjacent ResizeHandle's direction. Focus inside the panel moves to its ResizeHandle as it collapses, and the panel is inert while collapsed.

components.name: Lightbox
components.description: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution. Supports single-item and gallery modes with prev/next navigation, optional zoom and pan for images, and native video controls.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the lightbox is open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the lightbox open state changes.

props.name: media
props.description: Media to display. Pass a single object for one item, or an array for gallery mode with prev/next navigation. Each item is {src: string, alt: string, caption?: ReactNode, type?: 'image' | 'video'}; type defaults to 'image', and zoom/pan is disabled for 'video'.

props.name: index
props.description: Current index in gallery mode (when media is an array).

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Callback when the gallery index changes via prev/next navigation.

props.name: hasZoom
props.description: Enable zoom on double-click, or Enter/Space/+/- via keyboard (images only). When zoomed, drag or use arrow keys to pan.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial image index in gallery mode for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: hasAutoPlay
props.description: Automatically start video playback when a video media item is shown.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be stylex.create() value.

components.name: Link
components.description: A styled anchor for inline and standalone text navigation. Supports external links, underline variants, tooltips, and custom link components for router integration. Use it for navigating between pages or to external URLs.

components.name: LinkProvider
components.description: Wraps your app to replace the default <a> tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Next.js Link) for client-side routing across all Astryx components.

props.name: component
props.description: Link component to use for all link elements in the subtree (e.g. Next.js Link). It receives accepted `href` and `to` values under the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop. Supported structured destinations, including their `protocol`, are checked without changing object identity. If either supplied destination is rejected, Astryx renders inert content without invoking this component; it does not pass undefined or fall back to the other destination.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render with the link provider.

components.name: List
components.description: List container with density, dividers, and header support.

props.name: children
props.description: List items (ListItem components).

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density for items. Under a finger, an interactive row's hit target reaches 44px where its neighbors leave room, with no change to how rows look or lay out.

props.name: hasDividers
props.description: Show dividers between items.

props.name: edge
props.description: Where each row's text, dividers, and hover and selection backgrounds sit, relative to the list's edges and the container around it. 'padded' keeps text inside each row's padding, so it starts a little in from a heading above the list and backgrounds have room around it. 'flush' drops the rows' side padding: text starts on the heading's line, and dividers and backgrounds stop at the row's content, with no room beyond it on either side. It works anywhere and suits static rows. 'outset' puts text on the heading's line and reaches dividers and backgrounds a little past it into the container's padding; it suits interactive rows in a container. 'bleed' puts text on the heading's line and reaches dividers and backgrounds to the container's edges with square corners, like Table rows in a Card. A row's first content is what lines up with the heading: its marker, icon, or avatar when it has one, otherwise its label. 'outset' and 'bleed' reach into the padding of the nearest container that shares its padding: a Card, Section, Dialog, or BottomSheet, or a transparent container such as a Layout region with explicit padding or a padded ScrollableArea. Place the List directly in that container's padding: padding that Stack, Center, or your own styles add in between is not counted. Drawers and the automatic padding of LayoutContent and LayoutPanel aren't supported yet. With no such container, including in a Popover, they look like 'padded'. In a container with less padding than the rows' own, text starts a little after the heading's line. A theme's inline padding on `item` replaces the row padding of every value, including the zero padding of flush.

props.name: edgeCompensation
props.description: Deprecated: use edge="outset", which this sets. Still works; edge wins when both are set. `astryx upgrade` rewrites existing usage.

props.name: header
props.description: Header content, associated with the list via aria-labelledby.

props.name: listStyle
props.description: List marker style. 'decimal' renders an <ol> element instead of <ul>.

props.name: start
props.description: Starting number for ordered lists (listStyle='decimal'). Sets the CSS counter to begin at this value.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value: not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: ListItem
components.description: List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary content. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode renders as given, so child components control their own text behavior.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary content below the label. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode lets child components control their own wrapping and line-clamp behavior.

props.name: startContent
props.description: Content rendered before the label area (e.g. icon, avatar).

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content rendered after the label area (e.g. badge, chevron).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; enables the invisible button pattern.

props.name: interactiveRef
props.description: Ref to a nested control (e.g. a checkbox in startContent) that owns the item's keyboard access and action. The row becomes an enlarged click/tap target that delegates surface clicks to it (useClickableContainer) and renders no invisible button/anchor, so the row adds no second tab stop (WCAG 4.1.2). Mutually exclusive with onClick/href; those are ignored when set.

props.name: href
props.description: Link URL; enables the invisible anchor pattern. The destination follows the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target attribute, only applicable when href is provided. target="_blank" automatically adds noopener noreferrer.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship tokens. noopener noreferrer are merged automatically for target="_blank".

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of the start and end content against the label, passed through to Item unchanged. `first-line` keeps a small mark (a status dot, an icon) level with the first line of a wrapped label. See Item.align.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disabled state; sets aria-disabled on the item.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Selected state; marks the item as the current one with aria-current="true" (a list item cannot carry aria-selected).

props.name: swipeActions
props.description: Swipe actions for touch, passed through to Item unchanged: the verbs a sideways drag uncovers on each side, each `{id?, label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?: 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'destructive', hasRemoval?}`. See Item.swipeActions; List clips its rows in the inline axis for them.

props.name: swipeBehavior
props.description: What a swipe does, passed through to Item unchanged. See Item.swipeBehavior.

components.name: Markdown
components.description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

props.name: children
props.description: The markdown string to render.

props.name: display
props.description: Display type. Markdown defaults to block. Use 'inline' for markdown spans embedded inside text.

props.name: density
props.description: Controls spacing between block-level elements.

props.name: headingLevelStart
props.description: The HTML heading level that markdown # maps to. Shifts all heading levels down to fit the surrounding page hierarchy. Levels exceeding h6 are clamped to h6.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Enables streaming mode; it uses incremental parsing and a smooth fade-in animation for chunk-by-chunk text delivery.

props.name: onLinkClick
props.description: Handler for link clicks. Return false to prevent the default navigation behavior. Link destinations in the markdown follow the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop: a blocked destination renders as plain text and never reaches this handler or a custom link renderer. Image URLs use a separate, stricter policy (every data: URL is rejected).

props.name: sources
props.description: Citation sources keyed by ID. When provided, [id] and 【id】 markers in the markdown that match a key are rendered as citation chips.

props.name: citationStyle
props.description: How citations are displayed inline. 'label' shows a chip with source title, icon, and border. 'number' shows a compact numbered badge.

props.name: contentWidth
