props.description: Max width for prose content (paragraphs, headings, lists, blockquotes). Tables and code blocks are unconstrained and can expand to the full container width. Use for readable line lengths in wide layouts.

props.name: contentAlign
props.description: Alignment of prose content within the container when contentWidth is narrower than the available space.

props.name: plugins
props.description: Ordered extensions created by createMarkdownPlugin(). Plugins may add bounded syntax, immutable typed AST transforms, and typed extension renderers. Use isMarkdownExtensionNode() to narrow extension data observed from other plugins. Renderer callbacks are pure; return a child component when hooks are needed. Omitted and empty lists preserve the released Markdown behavior.

props.name: inlinePlugins
props.description: Transforms regex matches in parsed text nodes into custom inline React elements. Use for prefixed identifiers, mentions, and other shorthand patterns. Inline code, fenced code blocks, and math are unaffected.

props.name: autolink
props.description: Opt-in autolinking of bare URLs and emails. 'gfm' applies GitHub-Flavored Markdown autolink-literal rules: bare https?://..., www...., <scheme:url>, <email>, and user@host all become links. Trailing sentence punctuation and unbalanced trailing close-parens are excluded; matches inside code spans, code blocks, existing links, and image alt text are skipped. Default behavior (option unset) is unchanged.

props.name: codeLanguages
props.description: CodeBlock language values a fence may name, each imported on its own (e.g. graphql from @astryxdesign/core/CodeBlock/languages/graphql) or made with createCodeLanguage. A fence whose language word is one of a listed value's identifiers renders with it, ahead of a built-in; a diff-<identifier> fence takes the diff layer over it; a later entry wins. Pass the same list to RichTextEditor or RichTextView so read and edit match.

props.name: components
props.description: Custom React component overrides for rendered Markdown elements (code, inlineCode, math, link, heading, paragraph, image, blockquote, hr, citation). Providing math enables `$…$` inline and `$$…$$` display parsing and receives `{value, display}`; omit it when dollar text should stay literal.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; className is provided for integration with non-StyleX systems.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; inline styles bypass StyleX optimization.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

components.name: MediaTheme
components.description: Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips. The base behavior flips color-scheme so all light-dark() tokens resolve to the correct side. Only a small set of tokens need explicit overrides beyond that. Themes can further customize component appearance on media surfaces via onDark/onLight in defineTheme(), with both token overrides (e.g. "--color-accent": "#90CAF9") and component overrides (e.g. ghost buttons get a border on dark surfaces).

props.name: mode
props.description: Surface luminance context: dark for content over dark backgrounds (light text, white-tinted interactions), light for content over light backgrounds (dark text, black-tinted interactions), auto to decide from the painted surface (no media context when the ambient text already reads on the surface at 3:1, otherwise the side that reads better), and off to turn it off explicitly. The element renders either way, so a surface can switch contexts without remounting children.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Which side auto uses when the surface cannot be measured: during SSR, on the first client frame, and whenever the backdrop is not knowable from CSS, most often a background-image, whose pixels need sampling (useImageMode) rather than a computed style. Ignored unless mode is auto.

props.name: children
props.description: Content to render with inverted token context. Components inherit the correct colors automatically.

components.name: MetadataList
components.description: Container for metadata items with column layout, orientation, and collapse support.

props.name: children
props.description: Metadata items (MetadataListItem components).

props.name: columns
props.description: Column layout mode.

props.name: label
props.description: Label display configuration. position controls label placement, width sets a custom label column width. Defaults to { position: 'top' } for multi-column layouts. Position is ignored in horizontal mode, which always uses { position: 'top' }.

props.name: maxNumOfItems
props.description: Maximum items to show before collapsing with a show more/less toggle.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout orientation. Horizontal mode flows items in a row with flex-wrap.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional title or heading above the list.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value.

components.name: MetadataListItem
components.description: A single labeled metadata value within an MetadataList.

props.name: children
props.description: Content value for this metadata item.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for this metadata item.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label text.

components.name: MobileNav
components.description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. MobileNav is the mobile counterpart to SideNav and accepts the same children. Use it on narrow viewports where a persistent sidebar is not practical. Inside AppShell, use MobileNavToggle as the trigger; it reads state from context automatically.

components.name: MoreMenu
components.description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu items: data array of actions, dividers, and sections. Same type as DropdownMenu items prop.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the trigger button (aria-label) and tooltip text.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant of the trigger button.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the trigger button.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default three-dot icon. Accepts any ReactNode.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the menu trigger is disabled.

props.name: placement
props.description: Position of the menu relative to the trigger. Logical: start/end resolve against the menu's own inherited direction (RTL mirrors).

props.name: alignment
props.description: Alignment along the placement axis. Use 'end' to align the menu with the trigger's trailing edge, which is usually what an overflow menu wants.

props.name: presentation
props.description: Presentation policy forwarded to DropdownMenu. `adaptive` keeps the anchored popover on pointer-based layouts and uses a BottomSheet on a compact touch screen: a coarse primary pointer, and a viewport narrower than the theme `md` breakpoint (768px by default) or shorter than 500px. Omitted, the menu is the anchored popover, and under a finger, on every device, the finger that opened it picks a row only after moving 10 px. Pass 'popover' to keep the pointer behavior on every device, the settle rule included.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the menu opens or closes.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: MultiSelector
components.description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges. Use it for filtering or when presenting a finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.

components.name: NavHeadingMenu
components.description: Accessible menu container and items for nav heading popovers. NavHeadingMenu provides role="menu" with keyboard navigation; NavHeadingMenuItem renders individual selectable items. Pass as the menu prop of SideNavHeading or TopNavHeading.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu items.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls min-width and item padding.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width override.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: NavIcon
components.description: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading and PageNavHeader to visually identify a section or application.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon element to render inside the circular background. Should be an Icon or similar icon component.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls. Use NumberInput for quantities, measurements, percentages, and similar inputs.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the input (always rendered for accessibility).

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when a valid text edit commits on blur or Enter, or when a step or clear control changes the value.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label (still accessible to screen readers).

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed between the label and input.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Whether the field is optional (mutually exclusive with isRequired).

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Callback fired on keydown events on the input.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Whether the field is required (mutually exclusive with isOptional).

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the input is disabled.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the input read-only: the value is shown at full opacity and still submits with the form, but cannot be edited. Unlike isDisabled, a read-only input is not dimmed and keeps its form value. Stepping is off in every form while read-only: arrow keys, the wheel, and the number steppers. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the input is disabled. With isDisabled, shows a tooltip on hover/keyboard focus and keeps the input focusable via aria-disabled (the field becomes read-only). Use this instead of wrapping a disabled NumberInput in Tooltip.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text to display in an info icon at the end of the label.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon to display at the start of the input. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: labelIcon
props.description: Icon to display before the label text. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status with optional message.

props.name: statusVariant
props.description: How the status message is placed relative to the input. attached overlaps directly below the input (bordered treatment); detached floats below as a separate element with spacing; tooltip hides the message box and surfaces it in a tooltip on the status icon.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value allowed. A smaller entry commits at this value on blur or Enter.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value allowed. A larger entry commits at this value on blur or Enter.

props.name: step
props.description: Step increment for the input.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the committed value while the input is not focused. The raw numeric value is shown on focus for editing and the formatted value is exposed through aria-valuetext.

props.name: isWheelEnabled
props.description: Whether scrolling the wheel over the focused input steps the value. Disable this when page scrolling should always take priority.

props.name: hasNumberSteppers
props.description: Shows increment and decrement buttons at the end of the input on fine pointers. Hidden on coarse pointers (such as touch screens); text entry and keyboard stepping remain available. Holding a button with a mouse or a pen repeats the step and commits once, when the hold ends.

props.name: units
props.description: Units text to display at the end of the input (e.g., "%" or "GB").

props.name: isIntegerOnly
props.description: Only allow integer values (no floating point).

props.name: hasClear
props.description: Shows a clear (×) button when the input has a value. When true, the onChange callback also accepts null to signal the user cleared the input.

props.name: htmlName
props.description: HTML name attribute for form submissions.

props.name: autoComplete
props.description: HTML autocomplete attribute.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: Whether to focus the input on mount.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Callback fired when the input receives focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback fired when the input loses focus.

props.name: onEnter
props.description: Callback fired when the user presses the Enter key.

props.name: containerXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the field container (label, control, and status together). No effect inside InputGroup (style the InputGroup instead) or in a `horizontal-labels` FormLayout. Root `xstyle`, `className`, and `style` are not accepted.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class name for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: controlXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the visual control box: the element that paints the border and background and holds icons and end controls. Never the native input.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Class name for the visual control box.

props.name: controlStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the visual control box.

components.name: Outline
components.description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes. Features a sliding indicator track that animates to the active heading. Each link is in the normal Tab order, and Enter/Space activate.

components.name: OverflowList
components.description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.

props.name: children
props.description: Items to render. Each child should be a single element.

props.name: overflowRenderer
props.description: Render function for the overflow indicator. Receives the list of hidden items (each with child and index). Only called when items are overflowing.

props.name: onOverflowChange
props.description: Called whenever the collapsed set changes: with the collapsed items once something collapses, and with an empty array once the row widens back out. Membership and order changes report even when the count stays the same; unrelated re-renders and callback identity changes do not. Silent while nothing overflows, including on mount. Use stable React keys for dynamic items.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items as a spacing token step (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10).

props.name: minVisibleItems
props.description: Minimum number of items to always show, even when overflowing.

props.name: maxVisibleItems
props.description: Maximum number of items to ever show, even when they all fit. The ceiling partner to minVisibleItems; extra items collapse into the overflow indicator. If less than minVisibleItems, the floor wins.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Wrap items across up to this many rows before collapsing the rest into the overflow indicator. A number, not a boolean. Leave undefined (or set 1) for single-line behavior. Assumes uniform row height.

props.name: collapseFrom
props.description: Which end to collapse items from when overflow occurs.

props.name: behavior
props.description: Controls which element is measured for available width. 'observeSelf' uses the container's own width. 'observeParent' observes the parent element, useful when the list should stay content-sized while still detecting available space.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object.

components.name: Overlay
components.description: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the root element.

props.name: content
props.description: Content rendered inside the overlay scrim.

props.name: children
props.description: Base content such as an image, video, card, or media surface that the overlay sits on top of.

props.name: showOn
props.description: Visibility trigger. Hover mode also reveals on focus for keyboard accessibility; hover-or-focus is an alias for hover.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controlled visibility override. When set, this takes precedence over showOn and touch toggle behavior.

props.name: scrim
props.description: Scrim background mode. Set to false to render overlay content without a scrim background.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the scrim appears within the base surface.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the overlay content within the scrim.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name(s) appended to the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling when possible.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the root element. Prefer xstyle for design-system styling.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the overlay root element.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results. Pick a variant to match the context: numbered pages for data tables, a count for large lists, compact for tight spaces, or dots for carousels.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page number (1-based). Page 1 is the first page.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the page changes.

props.name: changeAction
props.description: Async action on page change. Fires after onChange and uses React transitions for built-in loading state.

props.name: totalItems
props.description: Total number of items. Used to calculate page count. Takes precedence over totalPages if both provided.

props.name: totalPages
props.description: Total number of pages. Use when you know page count but not item count.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether more pages exist after the current one. Use for cursor-based pagination where total is unknown.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Number of items per page. Coerced to a positive integer; non-finite values fall back to the default.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Available page size options. Shows a page size selector dropdown when provided.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Called when the page size changes. Automatically resets to page 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant controlling what appears between prev/next buttons. 'pages' shows page number buttons with ellipsis, 'count' shows 'X-Y of Z' text, 'compact' shows 'Page X of Y' (add first/last buttons with hasFirstLast), 'dots' shows dot indicators, 'input' shows an editable page-number box with a leading label ('Page [ n ] / N') flanked by first/last buttons by default (the box needs a known total to clamp against, so it is disabled in cursor/hasMore mode), 'none' shows just prev/next buttons.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: The noun rendered before the editable box in the 'input' variant, e.g. 'Page' or 'Row'. Navigation is always page-based (via onChange); this only relabels the box. Defaults to the localized 'Page'.

props.name: hasFirstLast
props.description: Whether to show first/last («/») double-chevron buttons flanking prev/next. Applies to the 'input' variant (shown unless false) and the 'compact' variant (shown only when true); other variants ignore it. Omitted when the page count is unknown (cursor/hasMore pagination).

props.name: step
props.description: Number of pages the previous/next buttons advance per click. Clamped to the valid page range, so a step that would overshoot lands on the first/last page. When greater than 1, the buttons' accessible names reflect the stride. Non-integer or values < 1 fall back to 1.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Number of page buttons to show on each side of the current page. Only applies when variant='pages'.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the pagination controls.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the component is disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the navigation landmark.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. Use it for secondary actions, inline confirmations, or supplementary information that does not warrant a full dialog. For hover previews use HoverCard, for brief helper text use Tooltip.

components.name: PowerSearch
components.description: PowerSearch is a structured filter bar where each token represents a field, operator, and value. Use it for complex multi-dimensional filtering when users need to combine multiple search criteria. For simple single-field search, use a text input instead.

props.name: config
props.description: Configuration defining available fields, operators, and their value types.

props.name: filters
props.description: Currently active filters.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when filters change. changeType is 'add', 'edit', or 'remove'. index is the affected filter's position.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the search input.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no filters are selected.

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: Auto-focus the input on mount.

props.name: hasClear
props.description: Show a clear-all button that removes every editable filter. Read-only filters stay.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Prevent adding, editing, or removing filters.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the entire component.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the search is disabled. With isDisabled, shows a tooltip on hover/keyboard focus and keeps the input focusable via aria-disabled (input stays blocked). Use this instead of wrapping a disabled PowerSearch in Tooltip. Disabled controls swallow the hover events an external Tooltip needs.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status object with type and optional message.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon to display at the start of the input, before any filter tokens. Forwarded to the internal Tokenizer. Accepts a semantic icon name, an SVG icon component, or a ReactNode directly.

props.name: statusVariant
props.description: How the status message is placed relative to the input. attached overlaps directly below the input (bordered treatment); detached floats below as a separate element with spacing.

props.name: maxTokenLength
props.description: Max character length for filter value display in tokens.

props.name: maxOperatorMenuItems
props.description: Maximum suggestions shown in string and entity value typeaheads. Does not affect the main field search menu or enum value menus.

props.name: maxSearchResults
props.description: Max ranked results for a non-empty query. Does not affect a field value editor. Browsing with an empty query shows up to 1,000 fields.

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Width in pixels for the main field/search menu. Does not affect field value editors.

props.name: popoverSaveButtonLabel
props.description: Label for the save button in the edit popover.

props.name: timezoneID
props.description: IANA zone a date-only date_absolute value, and each absolute part of a date_range, is read and written in: the day shows, edits and stores (as that midnight) in it; unset, a day is its UTC day. A date_absolute with isDateOnly: false shows and edits its date and time in it; unset, in the viewer's zone. E.g. "America/New_York". Date values are written in the InternationalizationProvider calendar, such as calendar="persian"; filter values stay Unix seconds.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Imperative handle with focusTypeahead() and blurTypeahead() methods.

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content to display at the end of the input row. Useful for action buttons or other controls.

props.name: resultCount
props.description: Number of results matching the current filters. When a number, formatted as "N results". When a string, displayed as-is. Changes are announced to screen readers via a polite live region.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the search input and tokens.

props.name: menuWidth
props.description: Maximum width for the operator/value dropdown menu in pixels.

props.name: maxOperatorMenuItems
props.description: Maximum number of items displayed in the operator dropdown.

props.name: tokenOverflowBehavior
props.description: Controls how tokens overflow when the container is too narrow. Forwarded to Tokenizer.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Fires when focus enters the search input.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Fires when focus leaves the search input.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value.

props.name: presentation
props.description: How the field presents filter editing. adaptive (the default) uses the bottom sheet on compact touch screens and the popover otherwise, resolved the same way Selector resolves it; the server render and the hydrating render are the popover. popover is the tokenizer field with its typeahead and the editor popover on every device. bottom-sheet makes the whole field, on every device, one trigger showing display-only filter tokens: it opens a Filters sheet listing the filters as rows that edit or remove a filter, with Add filter, Done, and Clear all (which asks first and keeps read-only filters); an Add filter sheet with the fields (or the content search with inline suggestions) opens above it, and a value step that stages operator → value and confirms from its footer opens above that. Dismissing a step reveals the one beneath. The flow edits a draft: adding, editing and removing filters and Clear all change the draft, and onChange is called when Done applies it, once per edit in order; dismissing the flow with a changed draft asks before discarding it. List values edit through the Tokenizer's own sheet. In the sheet presentation menuWidth and tokenOverflowBehavior have no surface to act on and warn in development. Pass presentation="popover" to keep the tokenizer field and the editor popover on every device.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. Under a finger a new value animates as on iOS: linearly, in proportion to how far it moves (a full track takes one second at the theme's default tempo), and the fill keeps a minimum visible length above zero.

props.name: label
props.description: accessible label

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (ignored when indeterminate).

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hide the label (remains accessible).

props.name: hasValueLabel
props.description: Show formatted value text (ignored when indeterminate).

props.name: formatValueLabel
props.description: Custom value label formatter; defaults to a percentage string.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic color variant.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: Animated loading indicator for unknown progress. Under reduced motion it pulses in place instead of sliding.

props.name: marks
props.description: Fixed target marks drawn on the track at values in the same 0..max scale as value (e.g. a goal line). props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Visually disabled state: grays out the fill and text. Use for canceled or inactive operations.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the radio group (always rendered for accessibility).

props.name: value

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the selected value changes.

props.name: children
props.description: RadioListItem elements.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Whether to visually hide the label.

props.name: description
props.description: Description text displayed below the label.

props.description: Layout direction of the radio items.

props.name: isDisabled

props.name: isOptional

props.name: status

props.name: size

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text for an info icon next to the label.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

props.name: containerXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the field container (label, control, and status together). No effect inside InputGroup (style the InputGroup instead) or in a `horizontal-labels` FormLayout. Root `xstyle`, `className`, and `style` are not accepted.

props.description: Class name for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.description: Inline styles for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: controlXstyle

props.description: Class name for the visual control box.

props.name: controlStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the visual control box.

props.description: Content shown in the dropdown panel when a search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. The selection surface, clear action, and disclosure indicator are removed. Unlike isDisabled, the control is not dimmed. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set.

props.description: The HTML name attribute for form submissions. Renders a hidden input carrying the selected value, like a native select.

props.description: Explains why the selector is disabled. props.description: Helper text displayed below the label.

props.description: Marks the field as required.

props.description: Validation status with an optional message.

props.default: 'attached' for input selectors; 'detached' for secondary and ghost selectors
props.description: How the status message is placed relative to the input. attached overlaps directly below the bordered input and is only valid for the input variant; secondary and ghost selectors detach attached status messages by default. Use tooltip for compact toolbar controls.

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Custom render function for each selectable option in the dropdown. Use this instead of JSX children; dividers and sections are rendered by the selector.

props.name: renderValue
props.description: Custom render function for the selected option inside the closed trigger. A one-line value follows the active size token, including compact or wide spacing scales with icons or a clear control. Padding accommodates the trigger line box, and each extra line grows the control by one line (28/32/36 for one line and 48/52/56 for two with the default tokens). Content inherits the trigger line height; content that sets a larger font should set its own line height so the trigger grows to fit it. Inside an InputGroup the group owns the row height: a SelectorOption folds onto one line and ellipsizes, and any taller node is cut off at the row.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Which logical edge of the option row carries a rendered selection mark. An empty mark consumes no space, so selected and unselected labels may shift or have different available width. end is the house convention shared with Typeahead and CommandPalette.

props.name: presentation
props.description: How the option list is presented. adaptive uses a bottom sheet on compact touch screens and an anchored popover otherwise.

props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned. Without a width the field follows its displayed value and can shrink with its row (the value truncates) instead of overflowing it; use `<HStack wrap="wrap">` for filter bars so selectors move to a second line on phones.

props.description: Enables collapse behavior. true for uncontrolled with default toggle button, or an object for controlled mode and advanced config (defaultIsCollapsed, isCollapsed + onCollapsedChange, hasButton, buttonLabel). A controlled config can also be passed to a SideNavCollapseButton rendered outside this SideNav, so both share one state.

props.name: resizable
props.type: boolean | { defaultWidth?: number; minWidth?: number; maxWidth?: number; autoSaveId?: string; onWidthChange?: (width: number) => void; defaultIsCollapsed?: boolean; isCollapsed?: boolean; onCollapseChange?: (isCollapsed: boolean) => void } | ResizableRegion
props.description: Enables a resize handle at the inline-end edge. true for defaults (260px initial, 180-480px range), or a ResizableConfig object (defaultWidth, minWidth, maxWidth, autoSaveId for localStorage persistence of width and collapse state, onWidthChange). It also takes the output of useResizable(), whose axis ('horizontal' | 'vertical') must be 'horizontal': that region then owns the width and the collapse state, so the rail follows its isCollapsed, the toggle calls its collapse and expand, and its autoSaveId saves the width. With the hook's output, the region's own collapsible option also decides whether the rail collapses; a collapsible prop that disagrees, or the collapse state it sets, is ignored, with a dev warning. The handle is hidden while collapsed.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds. Supports single value and range selection, tick marks, custom value formatting, and vertical orientation. Use it when users need to explore a continuous range, such as volume, price, or percentage. Under a finger, on any touch device, it tracks as UISlider does: only the thumb takes a drag, through a target larger than it, the value follows the finger’s travel rather than jumping to it, a release coasts on before `onChangeEnd`, a swipe from the track scrolls the page, and a tap on the track or a mark sets the value when the finger lifts (the thumb springs there). A mouse drag on a thumb tracks the same way, past the same 10 px in any direction, with no lift or coast; a mouse press on the track moves the thumb there, and only a primary click presses. A pen drags as a finger does, claiming only along the track, and its drag ends at the release with no coast. A wheel or a trackpad scroll over the slider goes to whatever scrolls under it.
