props.description: The full data array rendered in the table.

props.name: idKey
props.description: Key extractor: property name or function returning a unique string ID.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Controlled set of selected item IDs.

props.name: setSelectedKeys
props.description: Setter for the controlled selected keys.

props.name: getIsItemSelectable
props.description: Should this row show a checkbox? Non-selectable rows are excluded from select-all.

props.name: getIsItemEnabled
props.description: Is this row checkbox interactive? Disabled rows are frozen: select-all preserves their state.

components.name: useTableSortable
components.description: Headless multi-sort plugin for Table. Call with a config object: `useTableSortable({ sort, onSortChange })`. Returns a TablePlugin to pass to `<Table plugins={{ sort: sortPlugin }} />`.

props.name: sort
props.description: Current sort state (TableSortState<TSortKey>). Ordered array of entries; the first is the primary sort, the rest are tiebreakers. An empty array means unsorted. Direction is the full word: 'ascending' / 'descending', not 'asc' / 'desc'.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when the user clicks a header cell to change sort. Receives the next sort state.

props.name: allowUnsortedState
props.description: Allow cycling back to unsorted. When true: 'ascending', 'descending', unsorted. When false: 'ascending', 'descending', 'ascending'.

props.name: isMultiSortEnabled
props.description: Enable multi-sort via Shift+click. Regular click still replaces the entire sort state.

components.name: useTableStickyColumns
components.description: Hook that returns a TablePlugin which pins a contiguous run of columns to the start and/or end edge of the table. Pinned columns get cumulative offsets and a soft, scroll-aware shadow over the scrolling content. An empty config ({}) is a valid no-op that pins nothing.

props.name: startKeys
props.description: Column keys pinned to the start (inline-start / left in LTR) edge: the contiguous run from the first column through the last listed key.

props.name: endKeys
props.description: Column keys pinned to the end (inline-end / right in LTR) edge: the contiguous run from the first listed key through the last column.

components.name: useTableTreeData
components.description: Headless tree plugin for Table: renders nested rows with per-level indentation and expand/collapse chevrons in the tree column (the first column by default), and reflects hierarchy on body rows via aria-level and aria-expanded. Composable with the other Table plugins: the canonical plugin order places tree before selection, so the checkbox column lands left of the indented tree column. Feed it the treeConfig from useTableTreeState, or construct the config directly for server-driven or pre-flattened trees. When no row is expandable (flat data), every transform is a pass-through and the table renders identically to one without the plugin. Known limitation: the tree column wraps its cell content, so textOverflow="truncate" tooltips do not apply within the tree column.

props.name: getRowMeta
props.description: Structural meta for a visible row: {id, level (0-based), hasChildren, isExpanded}.

props.name: onToggleItem
props.description: Toggle a row's expansion.

props.name: getRowLabel
props.description: Derive a human-readable row identity for the expander. Astryx combines it with localized expand/collapse wording. Omit it, or return blank text, to keep the generic "Expand row" and "Collapse row" labels.

props.name: hasExpandableRows
props.description: Whether any row in the dataset is expandable. When false the plugin is a no-op: no expanders, no indent, no tree ARIA.

props.name: hasExpandAllControl
props.description: Show an expand-all/collapse-all toggle in the tree column header. Requires isAllExpanded plus onExpandAll/onCollapseAll (all supplied by useTableTreeState).

props.name: isAllExpanded
props.description: Aggregate expansion state across every expandable row, driving the header expand-all toggle. true when all are expanded, false when none are, indeterminate when some are.

props.name: onExpandAll
props.description: Expand every expandable row. Wired to the header control.

props.name: onCollapseAll
props.description: Collapse every row. Wired to the header control.

props.name: indent
props.description: Indent step per level, mapped to the spacing-3 / spacing-4 / spacing-6 tokens.

props.name: treeColumnKey
props.description: Column that carries the indent + expander. Defaults to the first column.

props.name: hasRowClickExpansion
props.description: When true, clicking anywhere on an expandable row toggles its expansion, in addition to the chevron. A pointer-only convenience: keyboard and assistive-tech users toggle via the chevron button. Clicks on interactive cell content (buttons, links, form controls) or a text selection do not toggle. Leaf rows stay inert, and it is a no-op on flat data.

components.name: useTableTreeState
components.description: State management companion for useTableTreeData. Owns the expanded set (controlled or uncontrolled) and flattens nested data into the visible row array; collapsed subtrees are unmounted, not hidden, so the table body contains exactly the visible rows. Returns expandAll/collapseAll helpers, the aggregate isAllExpanded state (true/false/indeterminate) for a header expand-all control, and a ready-to-use config for the tree plugin. Note: because collapsed rows unmount, cell-local React state inside collapsed subtrees is lost on collapse; lift state that must survive.

props.name: data
props.description: Nested data: rows may carry child rows under childrenKey. Flat data (no children anywhere) makes the plugin a no-op, so it can be adopted before the data becomes hierarchical.

props.name: idKey
props.description: Row ID accessor: property name or function returning a unique id.

props.name: childrenKey
props.description: Property holding each row's children array.

props.name: defaultExpandedIds
props.description: Initial expanded row ids for uncontrolled mode. Ignored when expandedIds is provided.

props.name: expandedIds
props.description: Controlled set of expanded row ids. Pair with onExpandedIdsChange.

props.name: onExpandedIdsChange
props.description: Called with the next expanded set whenever expansion changes (both modes). In lazy-loading setups, trigger the children fetch here.

props.name: isItemExpandable
props.description: Should this row show an expander? Overrides the default non-empty-children check; use for lazy loading, where a row is expandable before its children have been fetched.

props.name: sortSiblings
props.description: Sort each sibling group independently during flattening; children always stay directly under their parent. Pass applySort from useTableSortableState to compose with column sorting.

props.name: indent
props.description: Indent step per level (spacing-3 / spacing-4 / spacing-6), forwarded to useTableTreeData.

props.name: treeColumnKey
props.description: Column that carries the indent + expander, forwarded to useTableTreeData. Defaults to the first column.

components.name: VisuallyHidden
components.description: Renders content in the accessibility tree while hiding it visually. Use for accessible names on icon-only controls, aria-live announcement regions, and supplementary screen-reader context. Deliberately has no styling props; the whole point is to stay invisible. `xstyle` is still accepted and ignored, only so code written against 0.7.2 keeps compiling; a planned minor removes it.

props.name: children
props.description: Content exposed to assistive technology while hidden from sight.

props.name: as
props.description: HTML tag to render as. Use a block element for live regions.
